gear-weapon#0000.src: A01 welded its chamber shut on the first shot. A05 kept launching the trigger instead of the shell. A11 launched both. When the A16 finally sent the ammo where you aimed it, the lead Corkian engineer wept, stamped "APPROVED" on the paperwork, and handed the blueprint to the Factory.
gear-weapon#0000.dst: A01 第一发就把弹膛焊死了。A05 老是把扳机射出去，而不是炮弹。A11 两个都射出去了。等到 A16 终于把弹药打到你瞄准的地方，Corkian 首席工程师哭了，在文件上盖了「核准」，把蓝图交给了工厂。
gear-weapon#0000.flat: A01 welded its chamber shut on the first shot. A05 kept launching the trigger instead of the shell. A11 launched both. When the A16 finally sent the ammo where you aimed it, the lead Corkian engineer wept, stamped "APPROVED" on the paperwork, and handed the blueprint to the Factory.
gear-weapon#0000._raw: A01 welded its chamber shut on the first shot. A05 kept launching the trigger instead of the shell. A11 launched both. When the A16 finally sent the ammo where you aimed it, the lead Corkian engineer wept, stamped "APPROVED" on the paperwork, and handed the blueprint to the Factory.

gear-weapon#0001.src: The last of her crimes was against herself. She reviled and hated, shattering any glass in which she might see her own cruel visage.
gear-weapon#0001.dst: 她的最后一桩罪行冒犯的是她自己。她唾骂、憎恨，砸碎所有可能映出她自己那张残酷面孔的玻璃。
gear-weapon#0001.flat: The last of her crimes was against herself. She reviled and hated, shattering any glass in which she might see her own cruel visage.

gear-weapon#0002.src: "Those bloody zombies don't kip down at night, what makes you think a curfew might bally-well help?" -General Graken, {p} Militia
gear-weapon#0002.dst: 「那些该死的僵尸晚上又不睡觉，你凭什么觉得宵禁他娘的会管用？」——Graken 将军，{p} 民兵
gear-weapon#0002.flat: "Those bloody zombies don't kip down at night, what makes you think a curfew might bally-well help?" -General Graken, {p} Militia
gear-weapon#0002._raw: "Those bloody zombies don't kip down at night, what makes you think a curfew might bally-well help?" -General Graken, Nemract Militia

gear-weapon#0003.src: A deep regret stains this weapon-once a healing implement of the scholar-priest, its gentle power was turned and twisted as his ideals and resolve were tested, and faltered. With its wielder long passed, perhaps it can finally be absolved of the atrocities committed by his hand... and remember the peace it has long forgotten.
gear-weapon#0003.dst: 这把武器沾染着深深的悔恨——它曾是那位学者祭司的治疗器具，可当他的理想与决心受到考验而动摇时，它温和的力量也随之被扭曲。如今持有者早已离世，或许它终于能从他亲手犯下的暴行中得到赦免……想起它遗忘已久的平静。
gear-weapon#0003.flat: A deep regret stains this weapon-once a healing implement of the scholar-priest, its gentle power was turned and twisted as his ideals and resolve were tested, and faltered. With its wielder long passed, perhaps it can finally be absolved of the atrocities committed by his hand... and remember the peace it has long forgotten.

gear-weapon#0004.src: The depths bring stability, order, security. Those above are weak, unable to withstand the pressure. Those below are concerned with what lies further down. Leave your lawlessness, your chaos, your delusions of freedom. Open yourself to the abyss.
gear-weapon#0004.dst: 深处带来稳定、秩序、安全。上面的人软弱，承受不住压力。下面的人只在乎更深处有什么。抛下你的无法无天、你的混乱、你对自由的妄想。向深渊敞开你自己。
gear-weapon#0004.flat: The depths bring stability, order, security. Those above are weak, unable to withstand the pressure. Those below are concerned with what lies further down. Leave your lawlessness, your chaos, your delusions of freedom. Open yourself to the abyss.

gear-weapon#0005.src: This item was named by someone from the community!
gear-weapon#0005.dst: 这件物品由社区里的某个人命名！
gear-weapon#0005.flat: This item was named by someone from the community!

gear-weapon#0006.src: This wand is capable of attacks so fast that it appears to flicker in and out of existence. Anyone able to access its full potential will be seen as only a blur to their enemies.
gear-weapon#0006.dst: 这根魔杖的攻击快到它看起来在存在与不存在之间闪烁。能发挥它全部潜力的人，在敌人眼里只会是一道模糊的影子。
gear-weapon#0006.flat: This wand is capable of attacks so fast that it appears to flicker in and out of existence. Anyone able to access its full potential will be seen as only a blur to their enemies.

gear-weapon#0007.src: The Fracturing brought Ahms into a shattered sky, sundering cliffs into an archipelago against the void. The tremors that linger carry an ancient power, bringing mountains to heel with ease and leaving devastation in its wake.
gear-weapon#0007.dst: “碎裂”把 Ahms 推上了破碎的天空，将崖壁撕成一片悬于虚空之上的群岛。至今未散的震颤承载着一股远古之力，能轻易让群山俯首，并在所过之处留下满目疮痍。
gear-weapon#0007.flat: The Fracturing brought Ahms into a shattered sky, sundering cliffs into an archipelago against the void. The tremors that linger carry an ancient power, bringing mountains to heel with ease and leaving devastation in its wake.

gear-weapon#0009.src: This bloody palette knife was used to kill only two people before it was abandoned - a killer who broke into a great artist's home, and the artist who struck the blow.
gear-weapon#0009.dst: 这把沾血的调色刀在被丢弃之前只杀过两个人——一个闯进伟大画家家里的杀手，以及出手杀了他的那位画家。
gear-weapon#0009.flat: This bloody palette knife was used to kill only two people before it was abandoned - a killer who broke into a great artist's home, and the artist who struck the blow.

gear-weapon#0010.src: Combined power of inscribed Uth runes and raw potential fuse to create an imposing presence, as this weapon is merely a spiritual extension of the user's desire for complete obliteration.
gear-weapon#0010.dst: 铭刻的 Uth 符文之力与原始的潜能交融，形成慑人的存在感——这把武器不过是使用者渴望完全抹消的精神延伸。
gear-weapon#0010.flat: Combined power of inscribed Uth runes and raw potential fuse to create an imposing presence, as this weapon is merely a spiritual extension of the user's desire for complete obliteration.

gear-weapon#0011.src: Soul-locking magic is one outlawed by Gavellian governments, only used by the most insidious and cruel of mages. One such enchantment looms dormant in this mundane-looking maul. Continued usage of the weapon threatens to release it upon the wielder, permanently binding them to the weapon.
gear-weapon#0011.dst: 锁魂魔法是 Gavel 各国政府明令禁止的，只有最阴险残忍的法师才会使用。这把外表平凡的巨锤里，就潜伏着一道这样的咒法。持续使用它，那道咒法随时可能反噬持有者，把他永远束缚在这把武器上。
gear-weapon#0011.flat: Soul-locking magic is one outlawed by Gavellian governments, only used by the most insidious and cruel of mages. One such enchantment looms dormant in this mundane-looking maul. Continued usage of the weapon threatens to release it upon the wielder, permanently binding them to the weapon.

gear-weapon#0012.src: There's an inscription written hastily lining the edge of the blade: "Before it is over, I will see you again... but I have been called. And I must answer."
gear-weapon#0012.dst: 刀刃边缘匆匆刻着一行字：「在一切结束之前，我会再见到你……但我已被召唤。我必须回应。」
gear-weapon#0012.flat: There's an inscription written hastily lining the edge of the blade: "Before it is over, I will see you again... but I have been called. And I must answer."

gear-weapon#0013.src: The reigning king of thieves in {p}'s underworld would brandish this golden dagger to his enemies so fast, you wouldn't even realise your wallet was now missing.
gear-weapon#0013.dst: {p} 地下世界当今的盗贼之王，会以快得惊人的速度朝敌人亮出这把金匕首——快到你根本不会发现自己的钱包已经不见了。
gear-weapon#0013.flat: The reigning king of thieves in {p}'s underworld would brandish this golden dagger to his enemies so fast, you wouldn't even realise your wallet was now missing.
gear-weapon#0013._raw: The reigning king of thieves in Almuj's underworld would brandish this golden dagger to his enemies so fast, you wouldn't even realise your wallet was now missing.

gear-weapon#0014.src: Legends whisper of an incredible blade, that ripples the ground and shatters the tide. Formed from the waves of the sea, it's said all who wield it are untouchable. This, however... appears to just be a regular old pen?
gear-weapon#0014.dst: 传说低语着一把不可思议的刀，能让大地起伏、击碎潮汐。据说它由海浪所铸，持有者都无人能碰。不过这个……看起来就只是一支普通的旧笔？
gear-weapon#0014.flat: Legends whisper of an incredible blade, that ripples the ground and shatters the tide. Formed from the waves of the sea, it's said all who wield it are untouchable. This, however... appears to just be a regular old pen?

gear-weapon#0015.src: It is thought that this primitive wand was used by early man to create the first spells. It is made from a wood that no longer exists.
gear-weapon#0015.dst: 一般认为，这根原始魔杖是早期人类用来创造最初法术的工具。做它的木头如今已经不存在了。
gear-weapon#0015.flat: It is thought that this primitive wand was used by early man to create the first spells. It is made from a wood that no longer exists.

gear-weapon#0016.src: Let its whispers guide your hand, and let nothing but a scar of resentment remain.
gear-weapon#0016.dst: 让它的低语引导你的手，只留下一道怨恨的伤疤。
gear-weapon#0016.flat: Let its whispers guide your hand, and let nothing but a scar of resentment remain.

gear-weapon#0017.src: To forge a weapon such as this from the cursed lava of the portal basin requires dozens, for each smith would lose themselves to the force of corruption before it is finished. The nightmarishly hooked blade serves no purpose but destruction, as intended.
gear-weapon#0017.dst: 要用传送门盆地那受诅的岩浆锻出这样一把武器，得动用几十个人——因为每个铁匠在完工之前都会被腐化之力吞没。那把带着梦魇般弯钩的刀刃除了毁灭之外别无用途，正如设计的那样。
gear-weapon#0017.flat: To forge a weapon such as this from the cursed lava of the portal basin requires dozens, for each smith would lose themselves to the force of corruption before it is finished. The nightmarishly hooked blade serves no purpose but destruction, as intended.

gear-weapon#0018.src: Under the waters, between the waves, there lies something-something beautiful.
gear-weapon#0018.dst: 在水面之下、浪涛之间，藏着某样东西——某样美丽的东西。
gear-weapon#0018.flat: Under the waters, between the waves, there lies something-something beautiful.

gear-weapon#0019.src: The power of the unknown. The mysteries hidden in dark corners, between the walls; the forgotten poems, the renounced names, the words spoken into the abyss and never heard again. Meld them, wield them; they are yours to command.
gear-weapon#0019.dst: 未知的力量。藏在黑暗角落、墙缝之间的秘密；被遗忘的诗、被舍弃的名字、对着深渊说出后再也没人听见的话语。把它们融合、驾驭它们；它们任你号令。
gear-weapon#0019.flat: The power of the unknown. The mysteries hidden in dark corners, between the walls; the forgotten poems, the renounced names, the words spoken into the abyss and never heard again. Meld them, wield them; they are yours to command.

gear-weapon#0020.src: Originally intended for a more benign purpose, this piece of royal technology has been repurposed by something with far more malicious intentions. Despite the electrified water spraying from it, the smell of death never seems to wash away.
gear-weapon#0020.dst: 这件皇家科技原本是为了更良善的用途而造，如今却被某种怀有恶意得多的东西改作他用。尽管带电的水不断从中喷出，那股死亡的气味却怎么也冲不掉。
gear-weapon#0020.flat: Originally intended for a more benign purpose, this piece of royal technology has been repurposed by something with far more malicious intentions. Despite the electrified water spraying from it, the smell of death never seems to wash away.

gear-weapon#0021.src: The unwieldy, yet imposing stature of this massive sickle strikes awe into those who view it. Those who have the will to wield it, however, seem to garner respect from all those around them, as though they had become a god.
gear-weapon#0021.dst: 这把巨大的镰刀笨重却威风凛凛，看到的人无不心生敬畏。而有意志挥舞它的人，似乎会赢得身边所有人的敬重，仿佛成了神一般。
gear-weapon#0021.flat: The unwieldy, yet imposing stature of this massive sickle strikes awe into those who view it. Those who have the will to wield it, however, seem to garner respect from all those around them, as though they had become a god.

gear-weapon#0022.src: Allies are exhausting, with their egos and beliefs, and pesky moral codes. Followers are much better-soldiers in your own perfect image, whose deaths are merely scaffolds to a world of your design.
gear-weapon#0022.dst: 盟友太累人了，有他们的自尊、他们的信念，还有烦人的道德准则。追随者好多了——照着你自己完美的模样打造出来的士兵，他们的死不过是搭建你心中世界的鹰架。
gear-weapon#0022.flat: Allies are exhausting, with their egos and beliefs, and pesky moral codes. Followers are much better-soldiers in your own perfect image, whose deaths are merely scaffolds to a world of your design.

gear-weapon#0023.src: Stories say that should anyone wield both of these fearsome gauntlets in battle, they will become unkillable in a fight. The second gauntlet, however, has never been found.
gear-weapon#0023.dst: 传说只要有人在战斗中同时戴上这两只可怖的护手，就会变得杀不死。不过另一只护手，至今从未被找到。
gear-weapon#0023.flat: Stories say that should anyone wield both of these fearsome gauntlets in battle, they will become unkillable in a fight. The second gauntlet, however, has never been found.

gear-weapon#0025.src: There is very little outside the purview of those with power. No matter the circumstance, those in a higher position can, will, and have justified their actions in different ways. Some reasons are fine, some are weak. But what sort of justification is there, for those in the highest position? You have the floor.
gear-weapon#0025.dst: 有权势的人管不到的事少之又少。无论情况如何，身居高位的人都能、都会、也都曾用各种方式替自己的行为辩护。有些理由说得过去，有些很薄弱。可对那些站在最高位置的人来说，又需要什么样的理由呢？请发言。
gear-weapon#0025.flat: There is very little outside the purview of those with power. No matter the circumstance, those in a higher position can, will, and have justified their actions in different ways. Some reasons are fine, some are weak. But what sort of justification is there, for those in the highest position? You have the floor.

gear-weapon#0026.dst: 跑得比他们快。想得比他们远。撑得比他们久。

gear-weapon#0027.src: Weightless as a fallen feather, yet lethal as a hawk’s descent. Its beveled edge reshapes the slipstream to cradle your form, tugging you through the air as you deliver strike after strike, movements blurring into a flurry of beating wings.
gear-weapon#0027.dst: 轻如一片落羽，却致命如鹰隼俯冲。它斜切的刃口重塑气流，将你托起，拉着你在空中穿行，一击接着一击，动作模糊成一阵振翅的旋风。
gear-weapon#0027.flat: Weightless as a fallen feather, yet lethal as a hawk’s descent. Its beveled edge reshapes the slipstream to cradle your form, tugging you through the air as you deliver strike after strike, movements blurring into a flurry of beating wings.

gear-weapon#0028.src: Let the land before you serve as the script for your words to write anew.
gear-weapon#0028.dst: 让眼前的大地成为稿纸，任你的话语重新书写。
gear-weapon#0028.flat: Let the land before you serve as the script for your words to write anew.

gear-weapon#0029.src: Mysterious runes, held by inexplicable ancient guardians, were once moulded together for study purposes. The experiment went awry, as the runic words Nii, Az, and Ek were combined in a reaction that resulted in the collapse of a civilization.
gear-weapon#0029.dst: 那些由不可名状的远古守卫所持有的神秘符文，曾为了研究而被熔铸在一起。实验失控了——Nii、Az、Ek 这三个符文之词交汇，引发的反应终结了一整个文明。
gear-weapon#0029.flat: Mysterious runes, held by inexplicable ancient guardians, were once moulded together for study purposes. The experiment went awry, as the runic words Nii, Az, and Ek were combined in a reaction that resulted in the collapse of a civilization.

gear-weapon#0030.src: Carrying this hefty staff, you feel a sense of security and emboldenment. Its protective powers ensure you stay far out of the grasping undeads' reach.
gear-weapon#0030.dst: 扛着这根沉甸甸的法杖，你会觉得既安心又有胆气。它的守护之力确保你远离亡灵那伸来抓人的手。
gear-weapon#0030.flat: Carrying this hefty staff, you feel a sense of security and emboldenment. Its protective powers ensure you stay far out of the grasping undeads' reach.

gear-weapon#0031.src: The show is about to begin.
gear-weapon#0031.flat: The show is about to begin.

gear-weapon#0032.src: Stone shorn from mountains by the roiling sea gathered on the shores of {p} one day, washed onto the sand in the shape of a massive spear. It was taken as an omen, and the stones were forged into a true weapon.
gear-weapon#0032.dst: 有一天，被翻腾海浪从山上削下的石头聚集在 {p} 的岸边，以一柄巨矛的形状被冲上沙滩。人们把它视为预兆，于是那些石头被锻造成了一件真正的武器。
gear-weapon#0032.flat: Stone shorn from mountains by the roiling sea gathered on the shores of {p} one day, washed onto the sand in the shape of a massive spear. It was taken as an omen, and the stones were forged into a true weapon.
gear-weapon#0032._raw: Stone shorn from mountains by the roiling sea gathered on the shores of Llevigar one day, washed onto the sand in the shape of a massive spear. It was taken as an omen, and the stones were forged into a true weapon.

gear-weapon#0033.src: Archers have often experimented with tipped arrows. Launching the substance itself, however, is an innovation. A viscous ooze corrosive to anything it touches, it remains to be seen if their remains will be seen.
gear-weapon#0033.dst: 弓箭手常拿各种淬了东西的箭做实验。不过直接把那东西本身射出去，倒是一项创新。那是一种黏稠的泥浆，碰到什么就腐蚀什么——至于中箭的人还会不会留下遗骸让人看见，还有待观察。
gear-weapon#0033.flat: Archers have often experimented with tipped arrows. Launching the substance itself, however, is an innovation. A viscous ooze corrosive to anything it touches, it remains to be seen if their remains will be seen.

gear-weapon#0034.src: An extremely rare metallic ore only found within the island region of Corkus, it is normally used in decorative dyes. However, a mishap one day caused the discovery of strange and cumulative effects when exposed to traditional magicks.
gear-weapon#0034.dst: 一种只在 Corkus 群岛地区才找得到的极稀有金属矿，通常拿来做装饰染料。不过某天一场意外让人发现，它接触到传统法术时会产生奇异而叠加的效果。
gear-weapon#0034.flat: An extremely rare metallic ore only found within the island region of Corkus, it is normally used in decorative dyes. However, a mishap one day caused the discovery of strange and cumulative effects when exposed to traditional magicks.

gear-weapon#0035.src: Hewn from the great obsidian spires surrounding the massive Nether gate, this fiercely-hooked dagger absorbs light and magic energy alike to create a desolate void wherever it is wielded.
gear-weapon#0035.dst: 这把带着凶狠弯钩的匕首，是从环绕巨大下界之门的黑曜石尖塔上凿下来的。它会同时吸收光与魔法能量，挥到哪里，哪里就化作一片荒芜的虚空。
gear-weapon#0035.flat: Hewn from the great obsidian spires surrounding the massive Nether gate, this fiercely-hooked dagger absorbs light and magic energy alike to create a desolate void wherever it is wielded.

gear-weapon#0036.src: The creator of this polished white blade insists that its true power will never be unlocked, for only those who are not influenced by the elements of the world know truly how to utilize it.
gear-weapon#0036.dst: 这把光亮白刃的打造者坚称，它真正的力量永远不会被解开，因为只有不受世间元素影响的人，才真正懂得怎么运用它。
gear-weapon#0036.flat: The creator of this polished white blade insists that its true power will never be unlocked, for only those who are not influenced by the elements of the world know truly how to utilize it.

gear-weapon#0037.src: The fabled weapon of the titular dark Assassin, the blade's small stature hides its true powers. Shadows undulate about the hilt.
gear-weapon#0037.dst: 这是传说中那位同名暗黑刺客的武器，小巧的刀身藏着它真正的力量。阴影在刀柄四周起伏流动。
gear-weapon#0037.flat: The fabled weapon of the titular dark Assassin, the blade's small stature hides its true powers. Shadows undulate about the hilt.

gear-weapon#0038.src: One who forsook all others in pursuit of their own gain forced an extension of their own will into existence. This culmination of that will consumes all it touches.
gear-weapon#0038.dst: 某个为了一己之利而舍弃所有人的人，硬是把自身意志的延伸推进了现实。那份意志的极致产物，会吞噬它所触及的一切。
gear-weapon#0038.flat: One who forsook all others in pursuit of their own gain forced an extension of their own will into existence. This culmination of that will consumes all it touches.

gear-weapon#0039.src: Your saviour is not coming.It's pulling towards something.
gear-weapon#0039.dst: 你的救星不会来了。它正被什么东西牵引着。
gear-weapon#0039.flat: Your saviour is not coming.It's pulling towards something.

gear-weapon#0040.src: Blood. Carnage. Death. Destruction. This is all Annihilation knows. A fury written into its very core, a violent rage building from an endless War. If it were to have its way, all of Wynn would fall to chaos.
gear-weapon#0040.dst: 血。屠戮。死亡。毁灭。这就是歼灭所知的一切。一股刻进它核心的狂怒，一场无尽战争中不断累积的暴烈怒火。若由它为所欲为，整个 Wynn 都会陷入混乱。
gear-weapon#0040.flat: Blood. Carnage. Death. Destruction. This is all Annihilation knows. A fury written into its very core, a violent rage building from an endless War. If it were to have its way, all of Wynn would fall to chaos.

gear-weapon#0041.src: And as the spring bursts, the blossom petals flutter in the wind amongst the ashes of your enemies.
gear-weapon#0041.dst: 当春天迸发时，花瓣便在风中、在你敌人的骨灰之间翩翩飞舞。
gear-weapon#0041.flat: And as the spring bursts, the blossom petals flutter in the wind amongst the ashes of your enemies.

gear-weapon#0042.src: A mystical sapling native to the shores of {p} has been fashioned into this simple staff. Even uprooted, you notice its continuous growth.
gear-weapon#0042.dst: 这根朴素的法杖是用 {p} 海岸原生的一株神秘树苗做成的。就算被连根拔起，你仍能察觉它一直在生长。
gear-weapon#0042.flat: A mystical sapling native to the shores of {p} has been fashioned into this simple staff. Even uprooted, you notice its continuous growth.
gear-weapon#0042._raw: A mystical sapling native to the shores of Mage Island has been fashioned into this simple staff. Even uprooted, you notice its continuous growth.

gear-weapon#0043.src: Forged from the fang of a ferocious beast. Despite its small size, it can land blows at considerable range.
gear-weapon#0043.dst: 以一头凶猛野兽的獠牙锻成。别看它小，攻击却能打到相当远的距离。
gear-weapon#0043.flat: Forged from the fang of a ferocious beast. Despite its small size, it can land blows at considerable range.

gear-weapon#0044.src: It looks like they spelled the name wrong...
gear-weapon#0044.dst: 看起来他们把名字拼错了……
gear-weapon#0044.flat: It looks like they spelled the name wrong...

gear-weapon#0045.src: Crafted from Mandragora roots and adorned with decorative wreaths of Elven pines, these wands are utilized in {p}'s solstice festivals to celebrate each passing year of Villager and Elven comradery.
gear-weapon#0045.dst: 这些魔杖用曼德拉草根做成，饰以精灵松枝编成的花环，在 {p} 的至日庆典上使用，庆祝村民与精灵又一年的情谊。
gear-weapon#0045.flat: Crafted from Mandragora roots and adorned with decorative wreaths of Elven pines, these wands are utilized in {p}'s solstice festivals to celebrate each passing year of Villager and Elven comradery.
gear-weapon#0045._raw: Crafted from Mandragora roots and adorned with decorative wreaths of Elven pines, these wands are utilized in Efilim's solstice festivals to celebrate each passing year of Villager and Elven comradery.

gear-weapon#0046.src: Seems like the name is misspelled a little bit.
gear-weapon#0046.dst: 这名字好像拼错了一点。
gear-weapon#0046.flat: Seems like the name is misspelled a little bit.

gear-weapon#0047.src: Beauty and fragility go hand in hand. As nature's blossoms and branches are delightful, so are they delicate. A single spark can set the whole world into glorious blaze.
gear-weapon#0047.dst: 美与脆弱总是相伴而生。自然的花与枝有多讨人喜欢，就有多娇弱。一粒火星，就能把整个世界点成一片壮丽的烈焰。
gear-weapon#0047.flat: Beauty and fragility go hand in hand. As nature's blossoms and branches are delightful, so are they delicate. A single spark can set the whole world into glorious blaze.

gear-weapon#0048.src: Built by Cerid to accrue raw static charge from the surroundings and direct it at opponents, the blade's chief failing is that the wielder is not rendered immune to their own discharge as intended.
gear-weapon#0048.dst: 这把刀是 Cerid 打造的，用来从周遭积聚原始静电、再导向对手。它最大的缺陷是：持有者并没有像设计的那样，对自己放出的电免疫。
gear-weapon#0048.flat: Built by Cerid to accrue raw static charge from the surroundings and direct it at opponents, the blade's chief failing is that the wielder is not rendered immune to their own discharge as intended.

gear-weapon#0049.src: The frozen drops lashing your skin. The roar of the wind filling your ears. You've mastered it all. You can shape the winds, direct the rain. You are the storm.
gear-weapon#0049.dst: 冰冷的雨点抽打着你的皮肤。风的咆哮灌满你的耳朵。这一切你都掌握了。你能塑造风、指挥雨。你就是风暴。
gear-weapon#0049.flat: The frozen drops lashing your skin. The roar of the wind filling your ears. You've mastered it all. You can shape the winds, direct the rain. You are the storm.

gear-weapon#0050.src: A blade of pure light forms in your hands. It moves of its own accord, a blinding radiance dancing through your enemies, using you as a vessel for its brilliance.
gear-weapon#0050.dst: 一把纯粹由光构成的刀刃在你手中成形。它自行舞动，一道炫目的光芒穿梭在敌人之间，拿你当作承载它光辉的容器。
gear-weapon#0050.flat: A blade of pure light forms in your hands. It moves of its own accord, a blinding radiance dancing through your enemies, using you as a vessel for its brilliance.

gear-weapon#0051.src: The storm is a wicked beast, built of buffeting gales and electric agony. But at the very heart of the tempest lies a sanctuary, a blink of respite, where the waves run radiant in every hue.
gear-weapon#0051.dst: 风暴是一头邪恶的野兽，由猛烈的狂风与电击般的剧痛构成。但在暴风的正中心，有一处庇护所、一瞬间的喘息，那里的浪涛闪耀着每一种色彩。
gear-weapon#0051.flat: The storm is a wicked beast, built of buffeting gales and electric agony. But at the very heart of the tempest lies a sanctuary, a blink of respite, where the waves run radiant in every hue.

gear-weapon#0052.src: Her crimes were against Man. She killed and broke, leaving lifeless bodies piled in her wake, and snuffing lives with horrific indifference.
gear-weapon#0052.dst: 她的罪行冒犯的是人。她杀戮、摧残，所过之处尸横遍地，以令人发指的冷漠掐灭一条条生命。
gear-weapon#0052.flat: Her crimes were against Man. She killed and broke, leaving lifeless bodies piled in her wake, and snuffing lives with horrific indifference.

gear-weapon#0053.src: A true tactician knows to throw even himself on the pyre, if it is for the greater good.
gear-weapon#0053.dst: 真正的战术家明白，若是为了大局，连自己也可以投进火堆。
gear-weapon#0053.flat: A true tactician knows to throw even himself on the pyre, if it is for the greater good.

gear-weapon#0054.src: A wand forged from the dust of life itself. It destroys and protects in equal parts.
gear-weapon#0054.dst: 一根以生命本身的尘埃锻成的魔杖。它毁灭与守护的分量同等。
gear-weapon#0054.flat: A wand forged from the dust of life itself. It destroys and protects in equal parts.

gear-weapon#0055.src: Behind you are the corpses of the weak, of those who deserved to die. Before you are those willing to join them.It's pulling towards something.
gear-weapon#0055.dst: 你身后是弱者的尸体，是那些该死的人。你面前是那些愿意加入他们的人。它正被什么东西牵引着。
gear-weapon#0055.flat: Behind you are the corpses of the weak, of those who deserved to die. Before you are those willing to join them.It's pulling towards something.

gear-weapon#0056.dst: 不过又是一场装模作样的表演。

gear-weapon#0057.src: A great magical cataclysm at {p} brought on by a strange, seemingly disconnected series of events resulted in this wand absorbing nearly uncontrollably high levels of magic.
gear-weapon#0057.dst: {p} 曾因一连串古怪、看似毫不相干的事件引发一场魔法大灾变，结果让这根魔杖吸收了高得几乎失控的魔法。
gear-weapon#0057.flat: A great magical cataclysm at {p} brought on by a strange, seemingly disconnected series of events resulted in this wand absorbing nearly uncontrollably high levels of magic.
gear-weapon#0057._raw: A great magical cataclysm at Mage Island brought on by a strange, seemingly disconnected series of events resulted in this wand absorbing nearly uncontrollably high levels of magic.

gear-weapon#0058.src: Despite the existence of the Nether Portal, few believe that it is possible to open such rifts with sheer force alone. None believe that a tool with enough power to accomplish such a monumental feat could exist. And yet...
gear-weapon#0058.dst: 尽管下界传送门确实存在，却很少有人相信光凭蛮力就能撕开那样的裂隙。更没有人相信，世上会有一件强大到足以完成这种壮举的工具。然而……
gear-weapon#0058.flat: Despite the existence of the Nether Portal, few believe that it is possible to open such rifts with sheer force alone. None believe that a tool with enough power to accomplish such a monumental feat could exist. And yet...

gear-weapon#0059.src: "The gravestone for the brother of that man, Sayleros? For whatever reason, it didn't have a proper name on it." -Sacre, {p} Priest
gear-weapon#0059.dst: 「那个叫 Sayleros 的人，他哥哥的墓碑？不知为什么，上面没刻正式的名字。」——Sacre，{p} 祭司
gear-weapon#0059.flat: "The gravestone for the brother of that man, Sayleros? For whatever reason, it didn't have a proper name on it." -Sacre, {p} Priest
gear-weapon#0059._raw: "The gravestone for the brother of that man, Sayleros? For whatever reason, it didn't have a proper name on it." -Sacre, Saint's Row Priest

gear-weapon#0060.src: Despite appearing as a basic blade when held, strange spiritual magic changes its form into a sharp, ring-like cutting edge when used to attack. Only one person was known to master the weapon's abilities.
gear-weapon#0060.dst: 握在手里时它看起来只是一把普通的刀，但攻击时，奇异的灵性魔法会把它变成一道锋利的环状刃口。已知只有一个人精通过这把武器的能耐。
gear-weapon#0060.flat: Despite appearing as a basic blade when held, strange spiritual magic changes its form into a sharp, ring-like cutting edge when used to attack. Only one person was known to master the weapon's abilities.

gear-weapon#0061.src: This blackiron blade was left to sear in the desert for months on end by a fanatical berserker. It burned him alive as he cut down those who opposed him.
gear-weapon#0061.dst: 一名狂热的狂战士把这把黑铁刀刃丢在沙漠里连晒了好几个月。当他砍倒那些与他作对的人时，它把他活活烧死了。
gear-weapon#0061.flat: This blackiron blade was left to sear in the desert for months on end by a fanatical berserker. It burned him alive as he cut down those who opposed him.

gear-weapon#0062.src: War does not bring destruction. With war comes chaos, and with chaos comes destruction.
gear-weapon#0062.dst: 战争并不带来毁灭。战争带来混乱，混乱才带来毁灭。
gear-weapon#0062.flat: War does not bring destruction. With war comes chaos, and with chaos comes destruction.

gear-weapon#0063.src: Empty threats, thrilling bluffs, false promises: a little bravado goes a long way. Wielded properly, diction can be just as fatal as a knife to the heart, and it's much cleaner besides.
gear-weapon#0063.dst: 虚张声势的威胁、惊心动魄的唬人、空头支票：一点虚张声势就能撑很远。用得好的话，措辞跟一刀捅进心脏一样致命，而且干净多了。
gear-weapon#0063.flat: Empty threats, thrilling bluffs, false promises: a little bravado goes a long way. Wielded properly, diction can be just as fatal as a knife to the heart, and it's much cleaner besides.

gear-weapon#0064.src: The carving on this antiquated spear writes: Locedtuh Hahod
gear-weapon#0064.dst: 这杆古旧长矛上的雕纹写着：Locedtuh Hahod
gear-weapon#0064.flat: The carving on this antiquated spear writes: Locedtuh Hahod

gear-weapon#0065.src: "My husband's such a scaredy-cat. What good is tomb raiding if you're not in the tomb?"  -Dr. Junes, {p} Archaeologist
gear-weapon#0065.dst: 「我丈夫胆子真小。不进墓里，盗什么墓？」——Junes 博士，{p} 考古学家
gear-weapon#0065.flat: "My husband's such a scaredy-cat. What good is tomb raiding if you're not in the tomb?"  -Dr. Junes, {p} Archaeologist
gear-weapon#0065._raw: "My husband's such a scaredy-cat. What good is tomb raiding if you're not in the tomb?"  -Dr. Junes, Almuj Archaeologist

gear-weapon#0066.src: The powerful psychic energies surrounding this bow are rumored to increase accuracy, though this has not been refuted by any reliable source.
gear-weapon#0066.dst: 传闻环绕这张弓的强大灵能可以提高准度，不过这一点目前还没有任何可靠来源出面反驳过。
gear-weapon#0066.flat: The powerful psychic energies surrounding this bow are rumored to increase accuracy, though this has not been refuted by any reliable source.

gear-weapon#0067.src: The wear on this humble war pick's blade has only made it more effective in combat, allowing its users to make unexpected parries of opponents' attacks by hooking and hitting through the weapon.
gear-weapon#0067.dst: 这把朴素战镐刃口上的磨损反而让它在战斗中更好用，使用者能用它勾住对手的攻击再顺势打过去，做出出人意料的格挡。
gear-weapon#0067.flat: The wear on this humble war pick's blade has only made it more effective in combat, allowing its users to make unexpected parries of opponents' attacks by hooking and hitting through the weapon.

gear-weapon#0068.src: The swirl of liquid muck drags you further, further down, into the grasping clutches of the gluttonous hands of the sludge. The earth must be fed; preferably, by something less powerful than you.
gear-weapon#0068.dst: 液态淤泥的漩涡把你越拖越深、越拖越深，拖进污泥那贪婪双手的紧紧抓握之中。大地必须进食；最好是由比你弱的东西来喂。
gear-weapon#0068.flat: The swirl of liquid muck drags you further, further down, into the grasping clutches of the gluttonous hands of the sludge. The earth must be fed; preferably, by something less powerful than you.

gear-weapon#0069.src: "It never rains here, but we hear the thunder echoing in the distance."  -Lanu, {p} Archaeomancer
gear-weapon#0069.dst: 「这里从不下雨，可我们听得见远处回荡的雷声。」——Lanu，{p} 考古术士
gear-weapon#0069.flat: "It never rains here, but we hear the thunder echoing in the distance."  -Lanu, {p} Archaeomancer
gear-weapon#0069._raw: "It never rains here, but we hear the thunder echoing in the distance."  -Lanu, Almuj Archaeomancer

gear-weapon#0070.src: Perhaps one is weak. To be ignored. Perhaps two are not much better. But what of five? Ten? Twenty?...
gear-weapon#0070.dst: 也许一个很弱。不值一提。也许两个也好不到哪去。那五个呢？十个？二十个？……
gear-weapon#0070.flat: Perhaps one is weak. To be ignored. Perhaps two are not much better. But what of five? Ten? Twenty?...

gear-weapon#0071.src: Despite the light weight of the weapon, the spearhead has been made from incredibly dense cosmic stone. A strong enough impact can directly destroy matter. Due to this danger, it is sought after to be destroyed.
gear-weapon#0071.dst: 这把武器分量很轻，矛头却是用密度惊人的宇宙石做的。撞击力道一够，就能直接毁灭物质。正因为这份危险，许多人都在找它，想把它销毁。
gear-weapon#0071.flat: Despite the light weight of the weapon, the spearhead has been made from incredibly dense cosmic stone. A strong enough impact can directly destroy matter. Due to this danger, it is sought after to be destroyed.

gear-weapon#0072.src: An attempt to contain dark within light, to strike back at brutality with compassion.  Reality protested. Bring together two forces, and all you have is discord.
gear-weapon#0072.dst: 一次试图以光容纳暗、以慈悲回击暴行的尝试。现实提出了抗议。把两股力量凑在一起，得到的只有不和。
gear-weapon#0072.flat: An attempt to contain dark within light, to strike back at brutality with compassion.  Reality protested. Bring together two forces, and all you have is discord.

gear-weapon#0073.src: From nothing to everything, forever past to forever more, the vastness of eternity is obscured by the sameness of tomorrow.
gear-weapon#0073.dst: 从虚无到万有，从永远的过去到永远的未来，永恒的浩瀚被一成不变的明天遮蔽。
gear-weapon#0073.flat: From nothing to everything, forever past to forever more, the vastness of eternity is obscured by the sameness of tomorrow.

gear-weapon#0074.src: As the void approaches nearer and nearer, the barrier between realms thins almost to a point... And yet, no matter how far you fall or how fast you fly, it will always lie just out of reach. Such is the indeterminate nature of the void, and its power that you harness.
gear-weapon#0074.dst: 随着虚空越逼越近，界域之间的屏障薄得几乎只剩一个点……可无论你坠得多深、飞得多快，它永远都差那么一点够不着。这就是虚空那不确定的本质，也是你所驾驭的力量。
gear-weapon#0074.flat: As the void approaches nearer and nearer, the barrier between realms thins almost to a point... And yet, no matter how far you fall or how fast you fly, it will always lie just out of reach. Such is the indeterminate nature of the void, and its power that you harness.

gear-weapon#0075.src: "Catch a fresh-raised corrupted, it's like catching a soldier without his morning coffee. Stumbly and unfocused." -Enzan, Retired {p} Soldier
gear-weapon#0075.dst: 「逮到一个刚爬起来的腐化者，就像逮到一个没喝早上咖啡的士兵：东倒西歪，心不在焉。」——Enzan，{p} 退役士兵
gear-weapon#0075.flat: "Catch a fresh-raised corrupted, it's like catching a soldier without his morning coffee. Stumbly and unfocused." -Enzan, Retired {p} Soldier
gear-weapon#0075._raw: "Catch a fresh-raised corrupted, it's like catching a soldier without his morning coffee. Stumbly and unfocused." -Enzan, Retired Ragni Soldier

gear-weapon#0076.src: This heavy crossbow forces a strange compulsion in its users when wielded. They will often refuse to even shoot unless entirely certain of a hit.
gear-weapon#0076.dst: 这把重弩会在使用者身上激起一股奇怪的执念：除非完全确定能命中，否则他们往往连射都不肯射。
gear-weapon#0076.flat: This heavy crossbow forces a strange compulsion in its users when wielded. They will often refuse to even shoot unless entirely certain of a hit.

gear-weapon#0077.src: The ember manifests kindness. The blaze manifests cruelty. Both share an origin within the sun's flame. But what separates warmth from ruin is not the fire, but the hand that calls upon it. Mercy and wrath are merely reflections cast by the same unblinking star.
gear-weapon#0077.dst: 余烬体现仁慈，烈焰体现残酷，两者同样源自太阳的火焰。但分开温暖与毁灭的不是火，而是召唤它的那只手。慈悲与愤怒，不过是同一颗从不眨眼的星所投下的倒影。
gear-weapon#0077.flat: The ember manifests kindness. The blaze manifests cruelty. Both share an origin within the sun's flame. But what separates warmth from ruin is not the fire, but the hand that calls upon it. Mercy and wrath are merely reflections cast by the same unblinking star.

gear-weapon#0078.src: There is no need to swing this weapon. Your skin crackles as the mere presence of the blade rends the earth beneath it, to falling skies and gaping chasms. Once the dust settles and the air stills, the sword is the only telltale remnant of the catastrophe.
gear-weapon#0078.dst: 这把武器根本不用挥。光是刀刃在场，就撕裂了脚下的大地，你的皮肤噼啪作响，天空坠落，裂谷张开。等尘埃落定、空气静止，这把剑就是那场浩劫唯一留下的证据。
gear-weapon#0078.flat: There is no need to swing this weapon. Your skin crackles as the mere presence of the blade rends the earth beneath it, to falling skies and gaping chasms. Once the dust settles and the air stills, the sword is the only telltale remnant of the catastrophe.

gear-weapon#0079.src: One of the first dwarven theories of the increasing quakes in east Gavel was that the freezing of a Dogun town in the Heights also froze a massive underground spring, disrupting the earth and chain-reacting across the province.
gear-weapon#0079.dst: 对于 Gavel 东部日益频繁的地震，矮人最早的假说之一是：Heights 的一座 Dogun 城镇被冻结时，也一并冻住了一处庞大的地下泉，扰动了地层，于是连锁反应传遍整个行省。
gear-weapon#0079.flat: One of the first dwarven theories of the increasing quakes in east Gavel was that the freezing of a Dogun town in the Heights also froze a massive underground spring, disrupting the earth and chain-reacting across the province.

gear-weapon#0080.src: "I got a name, known far and wide! Run along, you bandit scum, before you have to learn it the hard way!" -Sayleros' Brother, killed by bandits
gear-weapon#0080.dst: 「我的名号远近皆知！滚吧，强盗人渣，免得你们用吃苦头的方式学会它！」——Sayleros 的哥哥，死于强盗之手
gear-weapon#0080.flat: "I got a name, known far and wide! Run along, you bandit scum, before you have to learn it the hard way!" -Sayleros' Brother, killed by bandits

gear-weapon#0081.src: Carelessly aloft, between the heavens and the abyss...
gear-weapon#0081.dst: 漫不经心地悬在高处，介于天堂与深渊之间……
gear-weapon#0081.flat: Carelessly aloft, between the heavens and the abyss...

gear-weapon#0083.src: The weapon of the fearsome lone bandit, {p} Luke, it is unique in that it is designed to fire small metal rounds instead of more traditional projectiles.
gear-weapon#0083.dst: 这是令人畏惧的独行强盗 {p} Luke 的武器，独特之处在于它设计成发射小颗金属弹丸，而不是较传统的投射物。
gear-weapon#0083.flat: The weapon of the fearsome lone bandit, {p} Luke, it is unique in that it is designed to fire small metal rounds instead of more traditional projectiles.
gear-weapon#0083._raw: The weapon of the fearsome lone bandit, Rymek Luke, it is unique in that it is designed to fire small metal rounds instead of more traditional projectiles.

gear-weapon#0084.src: "We'll ensure that under our watch, all your families will be reunited!" -Haros, of the Banished Legion
gear-weapon#0084.dst: 「有我们守着，保证你们全家都能团聚！」——Haros，放逐军团
gear-weapon#0084.flat: "We'll ensure that under our watch, all your families will be reunited!" -Haros, of the Banished Legion

gear-weapon#0085.src: Decay spreads unseen, but you know it spreads, and that is enough.
gear-weapon#0085.dst: 腐朽在看不见的地方蔓延，但你知道它在蔓延，这就够了。
gear-weapon#0085.flat: Decay spreads unseen, but you know it spreads, and that is enough.

gear-weapon#0086.src: "The first time I saw one of those zombies I nearly had a heart attack! The blighters are terrifying." -Rynend, {p} Citizen
gear-weapon#0086.dst: 「我第一次看到那种僵尸，差点心脏病发！那些混账东西太吓人了。」——Rynend，{p} 居民
gear-weapon#0086.flat: "The first time I saw one of those zombies I nearly had a heart attack! The blighters are terrifying." -Rynend, {p} Citizen
gear-weapon#0086._raw: "The first time I saw one of those zombies I nearly had a heart attack! The blighters are terrifying." -Rynend, Maltic Citizen

gear-weapon#0087.src: This artefact begins deteriorating your flesh from the moment it touches your skin, but its destructive force can be channeled to rot the bodies of any who come near.
gear-weapon#0087.dst: 这件器物一碰到你的皮肤，就开始让你的血肉坏死；但它的破坏之力可以被引导出去，让任何靠近的人身体腐烂。
gear-weapon#0087.flat: This artefact begins deteriorating your flesh from the moment it touches your skin, but its destructive force can be channeled to rot the bodies of any who come near.

gear-weapon#0088.src: A dusty old tome, containing all the powers of the abyss. From its pages spring forth the blackest of secrets and the darkest of truths. Do not let yourself slip into its grasp, for it will consume you too.
gear-weapon#0088.dst: 一本积满灰尘的古老书卷，蕴藏着深渊的全部力量。书页间涌出最漆黑的秘密与最黑暗的真相。千万别让自己落入它的掌握，因为它也会把你吞噬。
gear-weapon#0088.flat: A dusty old tome, containing all the powers of the abyss. From its pages spring forth the blackest of secrets and the darkest of truths. Do not let yourself slip into its grasp, for it will consume you too.

gear-weapon#0089.src: One of {p}' buildings was struck by lightning {~} years ago and burnt to the ground, apart from one wooden beam that began to glow. It was fashioned into an exclusive wand for resident mages.
gear-weapon#0089.dst: {~} 年前，{p} 的一栋建筑遭雷击烧成灰烬，只有一根木梁幸存下来，并开始发光。它被削制成一根专供当地法师使用的魔杖。
gear-weapon#0089.flat: One of {p}' buildings was struck by lightning {~} years ago and burnt to the ground, apart from one wooden beam that began to glow. It was fashioned into an exclusive wand for resident mages.
gear-weapon#0089._raw: One of Detlas' buildings was struck by lightning 60 years ago and burnt to the ground, apart from one wooden beam that began to glow. It was fashioned into an exclusive wand for resident mages.

gear-weapon#0090.src: One of the most unstable wands known to man. Using the bark of the Flerisi trunk, it reaps fiery destruction upon its enemies.
gear-weapon#0090.dst: 人类已知最不稳定的魔杖之一。它以 Flerisi 树干的树皮制成，为敌人带来烈火般的毁灭。
gear-weapon#0090.flat: One of the most unstable wands known to man. Using the bark of the Flerisi trunk, it reaps fiery destruction upon its enemies.

gear-weapon#0091.src: Often, the leader of brute gangs would use this dagger to threaten his followers into making sure they did not fail him.
gear-weapon#0091.dst: 暴徒帮派的头目常拿这把匕首威胁手下，确保他们不敢让他失望。
gear-weapon#0091.flat: Often, the leader of brute gangs would use this dagger to threaten his followers into making sure they did not fail him.

gear-weapon#0092.src: Strangers held together by shared past, entwined in a fray, never to unite again.
gear-weapon#0092.dst: 被共同的过去系在一起的陌生人，在一场混战中交缠，从此再也不会重聚。
gear-weapon#0092.flat: Strangers held together by shared past, entwined in a fray, never to unite again.

gear-weapon#0093.src: Unruly magics of void and darkness are tamed within this bow's string. While those energies are never to be released, arrows fired from it fire at such blinding speeds so as to phase out of existence when they hit their target.
gear-weapon#0093.dst: 虚空与黑暗那难以驾驭的魔法被驯服在这张弓的弦里。那些能量永远不会被释放，但从它射出的箭快得惊人，命中目标时甚至会从存在中消失。
gear-weapon#0093.flat: Unruly magics of void and darkness are tamed within this bow's string. While those energies are never to be released, arrows fired from it fire at such blinding speeds so as to phase out of existence when they hit their target.

gear-weapon#0094.src: The world is only as small as your heart makes it out to be.
gear-weapon#0094.dst: 世界的大小，只取决于你的心把它想得多小。
gear-weapon#0094.flat: The world is only as small as your heart makes it out to be.

gear-weapon#0095.src: Infiltrating a mind is tricky business; warping its thoughts, taking its wishes. It requires precision, skill, and more than a fair bit of luck.
gear-weapon#0095.dst: 潜入一个人的心智是件棘手的事：扭曲他的想法，夺走他的愿望。这需要精准、技巧，还有不少运气。
gear-weapon#0095.flat: Infiltrating a mind is tricky business; warping its thoughts, taking its wishes. It requires precision, skill, and more than a fair bit of luck.

gear-weapon#0096.src: "You don't really advance much when it comes to ovens. For clay, glass, ceramics...it was perfected a long time ago." -Treous, {p} Glassblower
gear-weapon#0096.dst: 「炉子这种东西其实没什么好进步的。烧陶、烧玻璃、烧瓷器……老早就做到完美了。」——Treous，{p} 玻璃匠
gear-weapon#0096.flat: "You don't really advance much when it comes to ovens. For clay, glass, ceramics...it was perfected a long time ago." -Treous, {p} Glassblower
gear-weapon#0096._raw: "You don't really advance much when it comes to ovens. For clay, glass, ceramics...it was perfected a long time ago." -Treous, Almuj Glassblower

gear-weapon#0097.src: They say the first sip of the ocean's wrath fizzes like champagne. The second burns with a sharp saltiness. By the third, the bubbles rise from your own drowning lungs as the sea claims its aperitif.
gear-weapon#0097.dst: 人们说，大海之怒的第一口像香槟一样冒泡。第二口带着刺人的咸味灼烧。到了第三口，泡泡就是从你自己溺水的肺里冒出来的——大海正在享用它的开胃酒。
gear-weapon#0097.flat: They say the first sip of the ocean's wrath fizzes like champagne. The second burns with a sharp saltiness. By the third, the bubbles rise from your own drowning lungs as the sea claims its aperitif.

gear-weapon#0098.src: Sever every last impurity of the self, and bring to fruition a brilliant culmination of 'you'.
gear-weapon#0098.dst: 斩去自我最后一丝杂质，让那个“你”得以璀璨地成形。
gear-weapon#0098.flat: Sever every last impurity of the self, and bring to fruition a brilliant culmination of 'you'.

gear-weapon#0099.src: The world is a well of wonder. To open your eyes each day is the greatest gift that can be given. The strength of a thousand lives flows through your veins, and the world embraces you with a reckless, terrible, beautiful, incredible power.
gear-weapon#0099.dst: 世界是一口奇迹之井。每天睁开眼睛，就是所能得到的最大恩赐。一千条生命的力量在你的血管里流淌，世界以一股不顾一切、可怕、美丽、不可思议的力量拥抱着你。
gear-weapon#0099.flat: The world is a well of wonder. To open your eyes each day is the greatest gift that can be given. The strength of a thousand lives flows through your veins, and the world embraces you with a reckless, terrible, beautiful, incredible power.

gear-weapon#0100.src: I can't see this through to the end. I have to put my trust in you to finish it.
gear-weapon#0100.dst: 我没办法把这件事做到最后了。只能相信你，把它完成。
gear-weapon#0100.flat: I can't see this through to the end. I have to put my trust in you to finish it.

gear-weapon#0101.src: This golden staff was recovered from deep within the tombs of {p}. Nothing else was found in the room except the words 'Beware the user with unlimited imagination.'
gear-weapon#0101.dst: 这根金法杖是从 {p} 的墓穴深处取回的。那个房间里除了一行字之外什么都没有：「当心拥有无限想象力的使用者。」
gear-weapon#0101.flat: This golden staff was recovered from deep within the tombs of {p}. Nothing else was found in the room except the words 'Beware the user with unlimited imagination.'
gear-weapon#0101._raw: This golden staff was recovered from deep within the tombs of Almuj. Nothing else was found in the room except the words 'Beware the user with unlimited imagination.'

gear-weapon#0102.src: This ornate bow holds a sinister beauty. Each rediscovery marks impending disaster, against any force that attempts to overcome it. Such is the inevitability of fate: irreverent to the will of masses, an epoch starts anew.
gear-weapon#0102.dst: 这张华丽的弓带着一种阴森的美。每一次被重新发现，都预示着一场即将到来的灾难，无论什么力量企图压过它都一样。这就是命运的必然：它不理会众人的意志，一个纪元又重新开始。
gear-weapon#0102.flat: This ornate bow holds a sinister beauty. Each rediscovery marks impending disaster, against any force that attempts to overcome it. Such is the inevitability of fate: irreverent to the will of masses, an epoch starts anew.

gear-weapon#0103.src: No one expected the WynnExcavation volcanic site to produce any valuable materials, but this heavy, obsidian-blend bow silenced the critics.
gear-weapon#0103.dst: 没有人指望 WynnExcavation 的火山工地能挖出什么值钱的材料，但这把沉重的黑曜石混合弓让所有质疑者闭上了嘴。
gear-weapon#0103.flat: No one expected the WynnExcavation volcanic site to produce any valuable materials, but this heavy, obsidian-blend bow silenced the critics.

gear-weapon#0104.src: The end comes in threes: first a deep and neverending shadow, suffocating all within its grasp. Then, a piercing blinding radiance, overtaking all within its sight. Finally, the in-between: chaos, bloodshed, war, a conflict which will sweep the land. Each end inevitable; but none a guarantee.
gear-weapon#0104.dst: 终结分三次到来：先是一片深沉而无尽的阴影，扼杀它掌中的一切。接着是一道刺眼炫目的光辉，吞没它视线所及的一切。最后是介于两者之间的：混乱、流血、战争，一场将席卷大地的冲突。每一种终结都无可避免；却没有一种是注定的。
gear-weapon#0104.flat: The end comes in threes: first a deep and neverending shadow, suffocating all within its grasp. Then, a piercing blinding radiance, overtaking all within its sight. Finally, the in-between: chaos, bloodshed, war, a conflict which will sweep the land. Each end inevitable; but none a guarantee.

gear-weapon#0105.src: Supposedly based off of the wand of master mage Ethe, this wand is plated with magic-focusing jewels and heavy gold, yet somehow remains entirely weightless.
gear-weapon#0105.dst: 据说是以大法师 Ethe 的魔杖为蓝本，这根魔杖镶满了聚魔宝石与厚重的黄金，却不知怎么地依然毫无重量。
gear-weapon#0105.flat: Supposedly based off of the wand of master mage Ethe, this wand is plated with magic-focusing jewels and heavy gold, yet somehow remains entirely weightless.

gear-weapon#0106.src: When really does the point of no return come? Is it a gentle tug, whispers ushering you calmly to the other side? Is it a stark line, the point between light and dark, life and death? Perhaps you'll find out. Perhaps you already know.
gear-weapon#0106.dst: 那个回不了头的临界点，究竟是什么时候到来的？是一次轻轻的拉扯，一阵低语平静地领你走向另一边？还是一条分明的界线，介于光与暗、生与死之间？也许你会弄明白。也许你早就知道了。
gear-weapon#0106.flat: When really does the point of no return come? Is it a gentle tug, whispers ushering you calmly to the other side? Is it a stark line, the point between light and dark, life and death? Perhaps you'll find out. Perhaps you already know.

gear-weapon#0107.src: Linked by blood, common cause, or pure fate, the clan is an immutable unit. Hundreds of hearts, beating as one, a collective pulse with the power to shake the world to its core.
gear-weapon#0107.dst: 无论是靠血缘、共同的目标，还是纯粹的命运系在一起，这个氏族都是一个不可分割的整体。数百颗心脏，同一个节拍跳动，那股集体的脉动足以撼动世界的核心。
gear-weapon#0107.flat: Linked by blood, common cause, or pure fate, the clan is an immutable unit. Hundreds of hearts, beating as one, a collective pulse with the power to shake the world to its core.

gear-weapon#0108.src: "Not every spider is venomous, but do you really want to get bitten by them all to figure out which are?" -Alvin, Nivla Forest Resident
gear-weapon#0108.dst: 「不是每只蜘蛛都有毒，但你真的想让它们挨个咬一遍，才搞清楚哪些有毒吗？」——Alvin，Nivla 森林居民
gear-weapon#0108.flat: "Not every spider is venomous, but do you really want to get bitten by them all to figure out which are?" -Alvin, Nivla Forest Resident

gear-weapon#0109.src: The confusion of sentience creates unknown and marvelous threads and soundscapes. Joy, grief, hate, love, shock, calm, they reflect back into the pattern and song of the universe. The glow of the Weave, and this brilliant, breathtaking, pale imitation of it, too, resounds in the chorus of existence-one extra layer.
gear-weapon#0109.dst: 心智的纷乱编织出未知而奇妙的丝线与声景。喜悦、悲伤、憎恨、爱、震惊、平静，全都回映进宇宙的纹理与歌声里。织网的光辉，以及这件璀璨夺目、令人屏息却又苍白的仿制品，也同样在存在的合唱中回响——多添了一层。
gear-weapon#0109.flat: The confusion of sentience creates unknown and marvelous threads and soundscapes. Joy, grief, hate, love, shock, calm, they reflect back into the pattern and song of the universe. The glow of the Weave, and this brilliant, breathtaking, pale imitation of it, too, resounds in the chorus of existence-one extra layer.

gear-weapon#0110.src: A mage by the name of Lero claims to have harnessed the sheer power of lightning using a magical staff, however, the weapon is very unreliable in a pinch.
gear-weapon#0110.dst: 一位名叫 Lero 的法师声称，他用一根魔法法杖驾驭了雷电的纯粹力量；不过到了紧要关头，这把武器非常靠不住。
gear-weapon#0110.flat: A mage by the name of Lero claims to have harnessed the sheer power of lightning using a magical staff, however, the weapon is very unreliable in a pinch.

gear-weapon#0111.src: A brilliant waltz on the razor's edge. Dance, dance through the fields of broken bodies and the vacant cities of empty people. Become the inevitable; the hands of time announce your interminable arrival. Raise your symphony to a crescendo, now: you are the dealer, and fate is the deck. The whole world will know your song.
gear-weapon#0111.dst: 刀锋上一曲璀璨的华尔兹。跳吧，跳过那片支离破碎的尸骸之野，跳过那些空了人的空城。成为必然；时间的指针宣告着你永无止境的到来。现在，把你的交响推向高潮吧：你是发牌人，命运是那副牌。全世界都会听见你的歌。
gear-weapon#0111.flat: A brilliant waltz on the razor's edge. Dance, dance through the fields of broken bodies and the vacant cities of empty people. Become the inevitable; the hands of time announce your interminable arrival. Raise your symphony to a crescendo, now: you are the dealer, and fate is the deck. The whole world will know your song.

gear-weapon#0112.src: Once a contract is formed, and before its details are discussed, a seal is placed on the human's body.
gear-weapon#0112.dst: 契约一旦成立，在细节谈妥之前，一道封印就会落在那个人类的身上。
gear-weapon#0112.flat: Once a contract is formed, and before its details are discussed, a seal is placed on the human's body.

gear-weapon#0113.src: Every time this spear hits an enemy, a sharp electrical jolt hits the users hands that forces powerful lightning to release.
gear-weapon#0113.dst: 这柄长矛每命中一次敌人，使用者的手就会被狠狠电一下，逼得强大的雷电爆发出来。
gear-weapon#0113.flat: Every time this spear hits an enemy, a sharp electrical jolt hits the users hands that forces powerful lightning to release.

gear-weapon#0114.src: Only the most honourable warriors of Gavel's army are presented the fearsome, fiery spear forged from the rarest metals of the {p}.
gear-weapon#0114.dst: 只有 Gavel 军中最荣耀的战士，才会被授予这柄以 {p} 最稀有的金属锻成、令人生畏的烈焰长枪。
gear-weapon#0114.flat: Only the most honourable warriors of Gavel's army are presented the fearsome, fiery spear forged from the rarest metals of the {p}.
gear-weapon#0114._raw: Only the most honourable warriors of Gavel's army are presented the fearsome, fiery spear forged from the rarest metals of the Molten Heights.

gear-weapon#0115.src: Gunpowder is your favourite scent. It signals peace: the enemies have been blown to high hell. And who doesn't love peace?
gear-weapon#0115.dst: 火药是你最爱的气味。它代表着和平：敌人都被炸上西天了。而谁不爱和平呢？
gear-weapon#0115.flat: Gunpowder is your favourite scent. It signals peace: the enemies have been blown to high hell. And who doesn't love peace?

gear-weapon#0116.src: A defiant pang joins the ruckus, a tune to run counter to the pain and the chaos of the rest. The strings of the forest are played just so, and the fall of each leaf echoes in an enchanted rhythm.
gear-weapon#0116.dst: 一声倔强的弦响加入喧闹，那是一段与其余的痛苦和混乱背道而驰的曲调。森林的琴弦被恰到好处地拨动，每一片落叶都回荡着着了魔的节奏。
gear-weapon#0116.flat: A defiant pang joins the ruckus, a tune to run counter to the pain and the chaos of the rest. The strings of the forest are played just so, and the fall of each leaf echoes in an enchanted rhythm.

gear-weapon#0117.src: Dwarven folklore tells of this mighty maul, used by gods to break mountains, shape continents, and crack the earth to form caverns.
gear-weapon#0117.dst: 矮人的民间传说里提到这把威力强大的巨锤，众神曾用它劈开山岳、塑造大陆、敲裂大地造出洞窟。
gear-weapon#0117.flat: Dwarven folklore tells of this mighty maul, used by gods to break mountains, shape continents, and crack the earth to form caverns.

gear-weapon#0118.src: An attempt to penetrate the depths of the abyss; a sacrifice made to a futile end. No avail. Bloodshed paved the way for bloodshed, and evil still operates while blind.
gear-weapon#0118.dst: 一次试图深入深渊的尝试：一场为了徒劳结局而做的牺牲。毫无用处。流血为更多的流血铺路，而邪恶即使目盲，依旧运作不息。
gear-weapon#0118.flat: An attempt to penetrate the depths of the abyss; a sacrifice made to a futile end. No avail. Bloodshed paved the way for bloodshed, and evil still operates while blind.

gear-weapon#0119.src: Found abandoned in the ruins of the Doguns, these odd weapons are designed to shoot jets of sheer flame instead of hitting enemies traditionally. They are in terrible disrepair, and none know how to fix them.
gear-weapon#0119.dst: 这些古怪的武器是在 Dogun 的废墟里被人发现的，设计上不是照传统方式打击敌人，而是喷出纯粹的火焰。它们损坏得非常严重，也没人知道怎么修。
gear-weapon#0119.flat: Found abandoned in the ruins of the Doguns, these odd weapons are designed to shoot jets of sheer flame instead of hitting enemies traditionally. They are in terrible disrepair, and none know how to fix them.

gear-weapon#0121.src: A hovercraft scrounged from voidstone. Stained glass dulled to bleak grays. Blueprints and notes in indecipherable tongues. Moments, lost in time-like so  much refuse from the world above.
gear-weapon#0121.dst: 一艘用虚空石东拼西凑出来的悬浮艇。彩绘玻璃褪成了惨淡的灰。写满无法破译文字的蓝图与笔记。那些瞬间迷失在时间里——就像上面那个世界丢下来的一大堆垃圾。
gear-weapon#0121.flat: A hovercraft scrounged from voidstone. Stained glass dulled to bleak grays. Blueprints and notes in indecipherable tongues. Moments, lost in time-like so  much refuse from the world above.

gear-weapon#0122.src: Curious, isn't it, that unending complexity can feel so plain in one's hand, yet pull deeper than eyes can see and minds can fathom?
gear-weapon#0122.dst: 很奇妙，不是吗？无穷无尽的复杂，握在手里却感觉如此平凡，却又能把人拉进比眼睛所见、心智所能测度更深的地方。
gear-weapon#0122.flat: Curious, isn't it, that unending complexity can feel so plain in one's hand, yet pull deeper than eyes can see and minds can fathom?

gear-weapon#0123.src: Freedom of soul, mind, and body are forced upon all those that this bow's arrows impact, and freedom of caring from the atrocities that such a dangerous weapon can inflict is given to all those that hold it.
gear-weapon#0123.dst: 被这张弓的箭射中的人，都会被强行赋予灵魂、心智与肉体的自由；而持有它的人，则被赋予另一种自由——不必在乎这么危险的武器会造成什么暴行。
gear-weapon#0123.flat: Freedom of soul, mind, and body are forced upon all those that this bow's arrows impact, and freedom of caring from the atrocities that such a dangerous weapon can inflict is given to all those that hold it.

gear-weapon#0124.src: It invites you to ride on the warm, soothing gusts it summons. It calls for you to admire the fires it leaves behind, burning the land to a char in its wake. It offers a lifetime of protection, while weaving a tapestry of flames across the world.
gear-weapon#0124.dst: 它邀你乘上它召来的温暖而抚慰人心的风。它呼唤你欣赏它留下的火焰——所过之处，大地被烧成焦炭。它许你一生的庇护，同时在世界上织出一幅火焰的挂毯。
gear-weapon#0124.flat: It invites you to ride on the warm, soothing gusts it summons. It calls for you to admire the fires it leaves behind, burning the land to a char in its wake. It offers a lifetime of protection, while weaving a tapestry of flames across the world.

gear-weapon#0125.src: The Dernel tribes revere various nature deities, each in their own unique fashions. One of the most notable was that of a lost tribe, who fashioned this blossoming stave as tribute to their deity of the earth itself.
gear-weapon#0125.dst: Dernel 各部族以各自独特的方式敬奉不同的自然神祇。其中最著名的一支已经失落，他们打造了这根绽放着花朵的长杖，献给他们的大地之神。
gear-weapon#0125.flat: The Dernel tribes revere various nature deities, each in their own unique fashions. One of the most notable was that of a lost tribe, who fashioned this blossoming stave as tribute to their deity of the earth itself.

gear-weapon#0126.src: Those who have used this near-weightless bow all seem to tell tales of how they see Gale's spirit fighting alongside them.
gear-weapon#0126.dst: 用过这张几乎没有重量的弓的人，似乎都会说起自己看见 Gale 的灵魂与他们并肩作战。
gear-weapon#0126.flat: Those who have used this near-weightless bow all seem to tell tales of how they see Gale's spirit fighting alongside them.

gear-weapon#0127.src: Well...it is a very pretty-looking stick, but aside from that it just appears to be a plain old stick.
gear-weapon#0127.dst: 呃……它确实是根很漂亮的棍子，但除此之外，看起来就只是一根普通的旧棍子。
gear-weapon#0127.flat: Well...it is a very pretty-looking stick, but aside from that it just appears to be a plain old stick.

gear-weapon#0128.src: Used for endurance training on the Icy Islands, this bow forces the wielder's body temperature to drop to near-hypothermic levels.
gear-weapon#0128.dst: 这张弓用于冰封群岛的耐力训练，会迫使持有者的体温降到接近失温的程度。
gear-weapon#0128.flat: Used for endurance training on the Icy Islands, this bow forces the wielder's body temperature to drop to near-hypothermic levels.

gear-weapon#0129.src: The blazing sun has been revered by many druidic sects as a god in its own right, and the jewel in this brilliant wand glows with the brightness of their holy star.
gear-weapon#0129.dst: 许多德鲁伊教派都把炽烈的太阳奉为一位独立的神，而这根灿烂魔杖上的宝石，正闪耀着他们那颗神圣之星的光芒。
gear-weapon#0129.flat: The blazing sun has been revered by many druidic sects as a god in its own right, and the jewel in this brilliant wand glows with the brightness of their holy star.

gear-weapon#0130.src: Pitch black and tipped with golden bands, it appears to grow at its wielder's whim. Strange runes are etched into the side, that flash with a heavenly light.
gear-weapon#0130.dst: 通体漆黑，顶端箍着金环，它似乎会随持有者的心意生长。侧面刻着奇异的符文，会闪出天国般的光。
gear-weapon#0130.flat: Pitch black and tipped with golden bands, it appears to grow at its wielder's whim. Strange runes are etched into the side, that flash with a heavenly light.

gear-weapon#0131.src: The stalwart Guard Golems stand as the protectors of Wynn's cities. To wield the remains of one so viciously dismembered by the undead... just how deadly are these hordes?It's pulling towards something.
gear-weapon#0131.dst: 坚毅的守卫魔像是 Wynn 各城的守护者。手里握着一具被亡灵如此凶残地肢解的魔像残骸……这些亡灵大军究竟有多致命？它正被什么东西牵引着。
gear-weapon#0131.flat: The stalwart Guard Golems stand as the protectors of Wynn's cities. To wield the remains of one so viciously dismembered by the undead... just how deadly are these hordes?It's pulling towards something.

gear-weapon#0132.src: Little spikes of corruption grow out of the blades on this weapon, serrating it. They seem to grow after drawing blood, guiding your body to dig further into the enemy's viscera even after they've already died.It's pulling towards something.
gear-weapon#0132.dst: 细小的腐化尖刺从这把武器的刃上长出来，把它变成锯齿状。它们似乎在见血之后就会生长，引着你的手往敌人的脏腑里再挖得更深——即使对方早已死透。它正被什么东西牵引着。
gear-weapon#0132.flat: Little spikes of corruption grow out of the blades on this weapon, serrating it. They seem to grow after drawing blood, guiding your body to dig further into the enemy's viscera even after they've already died.It's pulling towards something.

gear-weapon#0133.src: It's a gravity as abstract as it is physical, of phenomena so fascinating one can't help but be pulled in.
gear-weapon#0133.dst: 那是一股既抽象又实在的引力，来自一些迷人到让人忍不住被吸进去的现象。
gear-weapon#0133.flat: It's a gravity as abstract as it is physical, of phenomena so fascinating one can't help but be pulled in.

gear-weapon#0134.src: The very first crossbow in existence was claimed to be utterly indestructible, but it is only true to a fault. The item cannot be broken, but solely because all damage to it is instead reflected onto the user. As its age is uncountably ancient, wielders will find themselves rapidly aging and withering away with even a mere touch.
gear-weapon#0134.dst: 据称世上第一把弩坚不可摧，这话倒是真的，只是真得过了头。它确实坏不了，但那完全是因为所有施加在它身上的伤害都会反弹到使用者身上。由于它古老得数不清年岁，持有者光是碰它一下，就会发现自己迅速衰老、枯萎。
gear-weapon#0134.flat: The very first crossbow in existence was claimed to be utterly indestructible, but it is only true to a fault. The item cannot be broken, but solely because all damage to it is instead reflected onto the user. As its age is uncountably ancient, wielders will find themselves rapidly aging and withering away with even a mere touch.

gear-weapon#0135.src: Found at the site of the {p}, a curse falls upon on all who don this glove; a decay of the body, to fester in their wounds, and a decay of the mind, to muddle all thought. With it, a notion takes hold: to suffer together is to suffer no more.
gear-weapon#0135.dst: 这只手套是在 {p} 的遗址发现的，戴上它的人都会遭到诅咒：身体的朽坏会在伤口里溃烂，心智的朽坏会搅乱一切思绪。随之而来的，是一个念头牢牢攫住你——一起受苦，就不再是受苦。
gear-weapon#0135.flat: Found at the site of the {p}, a curse falls upon on all who don this glove; a decay of the body, to fester in their wounds, and a decay of the mind, to muddle all thought. With it, a notion takes hold: to suffer together is to suffer no more.
gear-weapon#0135._raw: Found at the site of the Caritat Mansion, a curse falls upon on all who don this glove; a decay of the body, to fester in their wounds, and a decay of the mind, to muddle all thought. With it, a notion takes hold: to suffer together is to suffer no more.

gear-weapon#0136.src: A vow of protection hangs over this spear, now inhabited by the spirit of a legendary heroine. Even simply a glimpse of the burning blade will instill a feeling of protection and security, and that feeling will hold true if one is brave enough to wield it.
gear-weapon#0136.dst: 这柄长矛萦绕着一份守护的誓言，如今寄宿着一位传奇女英雄的灵魂。光是瞥一眼那燃烧的矛刃，就会让人心生被守护的安全感——而若有人敢于挥舞它，这份感觉便会成真。
gear-weapon#0136.flat: A vow of protection hangs over this spear, now inhabited by the spirit of a legendary heroine. Even simply a glimpse of the burning blade will instill a feeling of protection and security, and that feeling will hold true if one is brave enough to wield it.

gear-weapon#0137.src: Carved from unknown parts of a sea creature unseen, the goliath scales of this effigy of the deep bring forth...a pull. A weight, a pressure. A terrible, crushing depth brought onto the holder, blanketing them like nostalgia. Their owner watches, part of itself acutely aware of its missing pieces.
gear-weapon#0137.dst: 这尊深海神像取材于某种未曾现身的海中生物身上不明的部位，那巨大的鳞片带来……一股拉扯。一份重量，一种压力。一片可怕而压碎一切的深度降临在持有者身上，像乡愁一样将他覆盖。它们原本的主人在一旁看着，身体的某一部分敏锐地察觉到自己缺了几块。
gear-weapon#0137.flat: Carved from unknown parts of a sea creature unseen, the goliath scales of this effigy of the deep bring forth...a pull. A weight, a pressure. A terrible, crushing depth brought onto the holder, blanketing them like nostalgia. Their owner watches, part of itself acutely aware of its missing pieces.

gear-weapon#0138.src: As a flashing star shot through the night sky, a sole observer witnessed its brilliance. It was then, wreathed in prismatic light, he decided. Someday, he would shine as bright as that star, and overtake those beneath him. No matter the cost.
gear-weapon#0138.dst: 一颗闪亮的星划过夜空，唯一的目击者看见了它的光辉。就在那一刻，沐浴在七彩光芒里，他下定了决心：总有一天，他要像那颗星一样耀眼，凌驾于在他之下的所有人。不惜任何代价。
gear-weapon#0138.flat: As a flashing star shot through the night sky, a sole observer witnessed its brilliance. It was then, wreathed in prismatic light, he decided. Someday, he would shine as bright as that star, and overtake those beneath him. No matter the cost.

gear-weapon#0139.src: The most dangerous enemy is one you cannot see. Hidden amidst a flurry of petals comes an avalanche of blows, in one moment dissolving mountains and forests into a growing amalgam, leaving a wake of vibrant bloom in the next.
gear-weapon#0139.dst: 最危险的敌人，是你看不见的那一个。一阵纷飞的花瓣里藏着排山倒海的攻势，前一刻把山林溶成一团不断膨胀的混合物，下一刻留下一路鲜艳盛放的花。
gear-weapon#0139.flat: The most dangerous enemy is one you cannot see. Hidden amidst a flurry of petals comes an avalanche of blows, in one moment dissolving mountains and forests into a growing amalgam, leaving a wake of vibrant bloom in the next.

gear-weapon#0140.src: The weathered oar of Haros, the outcast ferryman of Charon's Forsaken Legion. Magical implements have been jury-rigged onto the silver pole, glowing dull out of his bony grasp.
gear-weapon#0140.dst: 这是 Haros 那支饱经风霜的桨——他是 Charon 遭弃军团里被放逐的摆渡人。银色的桨杆上胡乱加装了几件魔法器具，离开他那骨瘦嶙峋的手之后，便只泛着黯淡的光。
gear-weapon#0140.flat: The weathered oar of Haros, the outcast ferryman of Charon's Forsaken Legion. Magical implements have been jury-rigged onto the silver pole, glowing dull out of his bony grasp.

gear-weapon#0141.src: Corkian technology was not the first to create an item that is capable  of recording noise. Artifacts from {p} were found to record ambient  sounds and distort them into ear-splitting sonic bursts.
gear-weapon#0141.dst: Corkian 的技术并不是第一个做出能录下声音的东西的。人们发现 {p} 出土的器物能录下周遭的声响，再把它扭曲成震耳欲聋的音爆。
gear-weapon#0141.flat: Corkian technology was not the first to create an item that is capable  of recording noise. Artifacts from {p} were found to record ambient  sounds and distort them into ear-splitting sonic bursts.
gear-weapon#0141._raw: Corkian technology was not the first to create an item that is capable  of recording noise. Artifacts from Time Valley were found to record ambient  sounds and distort them into ear-splitting sonic bursts.

gear-weapon#0142.src: The runes carved onto the spear shift appearance so quickly as to be illegible, but those who wield it supposedly will learn their meaning.
gear-weapon#0142.dst: 刻在矛上的符文变换得太快，根本读不出来，但据说挥舞它的人终将明白其中的意义。
gear-weapon#0142.flat: The runes carved onto the spear shift appearance so quickly as to be illegible, but those who wield it supposedly will learn their meaning.

gear-weapon#0143.src: "Betrayal stings sharper than a scorpion's tail, and festers worse than the poison inside."   -Attributed to Hashr
gear-weapon#0143.dst: 「背叛比蝎子的尾刺更扎人，溃烂得也比里头的毒液更厉害。」——据传出自 Hashr
gear-weapon#0143.flat: "Betrayal stings sharper than a scorpion's tail, and festers worse than the poison inside."   -Attributed to Hashr

gear-weapon#0144.src: Everything slowly loses heat, and will eventually stop moving. Are you prepared?
gear-weapon#0144.dst: 万物都在慢慢失去热量，终将停止运动。你准备好了吗？
gear-weapon#0144.flat: Everything slowly loses heat, and will eventually stop moving. Are you prepared?

gear-weapon#0145.src: Among the outcasts of {p}, some preach that death is not to be feared. They say while the road to his door is hellish, and his messenger most cruel, the beyond forgives. In this gilded spear, you see not only a weapon, but a key, a ticket. You know what to do. Be the messenger.
gear-weapon#0145.dst: {p} 的弃民之中，有人宣扬死亡并不可怕。他们说，通往他门前的路虽如地狱，他的使者虽最残忍，彼岸却会宽恕一切。在这柄镀金长矛里，你看见的不只是一把武器，而是一把钥匙、一张门票。你知道该怎么做。去当那个使者吧。
gear-weapon#0145.flat: Among the outcasts of {p}, some preach that death is not to be feared. They say while the road to his door is hellish, and his messenger most cruel, the beyond forgives. In this gilded spear, you see not only a weapon, but a key, a ticket. You know what to do. Be the messenger.
gear-weapon#0145._raw: Among the outcasts of Efilim, some preach that death is not to be feared. They say while the road to his door is hellish, and his messenger most cruel, the beyond forgives. In this gilded spear, you see not only a weapon, but a key, a ticket. You know what to do. Be the messenger.

gear-weapon#0146.src: For the hundreds sacrificed for {p}'s survival, death was not the end. Residual dark magic and corrupted energy manifests in this weapon as faint echoes of sorrow and agony from the slain who were denied peace.It's pulling towards something.
gear-weapon#0146.dst: 对那些为了 {p} 的存续而被牺牲的数百人来说，死亡并不是终点。残留的黑暗魔法与腐化能量在这把武器里显现，化作那些不得安息的亡者微弱的悲恸与痛苦回响。它正被什么东西牵引着。
gear-weapon#0146.flat: For the hundreds sacrificed for {p}'s survival, death was not the end. Residual dark magic and corrupted energy manifests in this weapon as faint echoes of sorrow and agony from the slain who were denied peace.It's pulling towards something.
gear-weapon#0146._raw: For the hundreds sacrificed for Troms's survival, death was not the end. Residual dark magic and corrupted energy manifests in this weapon as faint echoes of sorrow and agony from the slain who were denied peace.It's pulling towards something.

gear-weapon#0147.src: Face the flames with resolution in your eyes. Once you're down in the brimstone, you're not going back.
gear-weapon#0147.dst: 眼神坚定地直面烈焰吧。一旦落进硫磺之中，你就回不去了。
gear-weapon#0147.flat: Face the flames with resolution in your eyes. Once you're down in the brimstone, you're not going back.

gear-weapon#0148.src: This profane bow was crafted by a Kander cabal in opposition to the House of Talor's holy relic. Holding it for too long will strain and warp the user's mind.
gear-weapon#0148.dst: 这张亵渎之弓是 Kander 密党为了对抗 Talor 家族的圣物而打造的。握得太久，会让使用者的心智紧绷、扭曲。
gear-weapon#0148.flat: This profane bow was crafted by a Kander cabal in opposition to the House of Talor's holy relic. Holding it for too long will strain and warp the user's mind.

gear-weapon#0149.src: One of Skien's many deadly weapons. This warhammer, despite the massive weight of the hammerhead, was able to be swung by Skien fast enough to be a blur.
gear-weapon#0149.dst: Skien 众多致命武器之一。这把战锤的锤头虽然重得惊人，Skien 却能挥得快到只剩一道残影。
gear-weapon#0149.flat: One of Skien's many deadly weapons. This warhammer, despite the massive weight of the hammerhead, was able to be swung by Skien fast enough to be a blur.

gear-weapon#0150.src: Reconstructed from mere wooden scraps of its former self, this extremely heavy crossbow still contains immense power. It was intended for use with a lost suit of armor, of which only one piece remains.
gear-weapon#0150.dst: 仅凭昔日残留的木料碎片重建而成，这把极为沉重的十字弩依然蕴含着庞大的力量。它原本要搭配一套已经失传的盔甲使用，而那套盔甲如今只剩一件。
gear-weapon#0150.flat: Reconstructed from mere wooden scraps of its former self, this extremely heavy crossbow still contains immense power. It was intended for use with a lost suit of armor, of which only one piece remains.

gear-weapon#0151.src: The calm before the storm is a time of preparation, of perseverance until clearer days. But this? This is the last moment of peace they will ever know.
gear-weapon#0151.dst: 暴风雨前的宁静是用来准备的，是为了撑到天色转晴。但这一次不是。这是他们此生所能知道的最后一刻安宁。
gear-weapon#0151.flat: The calm before the storm is a time of preparation, of perseverance until clearer days. But this? This is the last moment of peace they will ever know.

gear-weapon#0152.src: Enigmatically, this weapon will only show itself to those who believe themselves to be worth nothing, or to be weak. While utilizing this weapon will greatly strengthen one's resolve, it will disappear when it is no longer needed, going to the next wielder.
gear-weapon#0152.dst: 说来神秘，这把武器只会向那些认为自己一文不值、或认为自己软弱的人现身。使用它能大大坚定人的决心，而一旦不再被需要，它就会消失，前往下一位持有者身边。
gear-weapon#0152.flat: Enigmatically, this weapon will only show itself to those who believe themselves to be worth nothing, or to be weak. While utilizing this weapon will greatly strengthen one's resolve, it will disappear when it is no longer needed, going to the next wielder.

gear-weapon#0153.src: Watch as they receive your gift of imminent disaster and endless fallout.
gear-weapon#0153.dst: 看着他们收下你的礼物：迫在眉睫的灾难，以及无尽的余波。
gear-weapon#0153.flat: Watch as they receive your gift of imminent disaster and endless fallout.

gear-weapon#0154.src: To quell the most hateful energies, to focus the most erratic wills, to understand the most alien voices, to shake the most uncaring forces, to capture the most ephemeral potential. The final work of many scholars: to command the world in its most pure being.
gear-weapon#0154.dst: 平息最充满恨意的能量，聚拢最飘忽不定的意志，理解最陌生的声音，撼动最冷漠的力量，捕捉最转瞬即逝的潜能。众多学者的毕生之作：以世界最纯粹的本质号令世界。
gear-weapon#0154.flat: To quell the most hateful energies, to focus the most erratic wills, to understand the most alien voices, to shake the most uncaring forces, to capture the most ephemeral potential. The final work of many scholars: to command the world in its most pure being.

gear-weapon#0155.src: "I saw that spider queen once. It felt like it was only a matter of time before she found my home, so I moved here." -Babhla, Nivla Bowl Merchant
gear-weapon#0155.dst: 「我见过那只蜘蛛女王一次。感觉她找上我家只是时间问题，所以我就搬来这里了。」——Babhla，Nivla 碗具商人
gear-weapon#0155.flat: "I saw that spider queen once. It felt like it was only a matter of time before she found my home, so I moved here." -Babhla, Nivla Bowl Merchant

gear-weapon#0156.src: The winds are a curious thing. The light breeze is calming, pleasant. The gale buffets and breaks things, as though it were a child's tantrum. Only the storm truly destroys, bearing its gusts against anyone or anything that would stand in its way, leaving behind only ruin and dust.
gear-weapon#0156.dst: 风是一种奇妙的东西。微风令人平静、舒适。强风拍打、弄坏东西，像小孩子在耍脾气。只有风暴才会真正地毁灭，把狂风压向任何挡在它面前的人或物，只留下废墟与尘土。
gear-weapon#0156.flat: The winds are a curious thing. The light breeze is calming, pleasant. The gale buffets and breaks things, as though it were a child's tantrum. Only the storm truly destroys, bearing its gusts against anyone or anything that would stand in its way, leaving behind only ruin and dust.

gear-weapon#0157.src: A blade crafted from the ocean's elements. It slices through enemies with the grace of the tides.
gear-weapon#0157.dst: 一把以海洋元素锻成的刀刃。它劈开敌人时，带着潮汐般的优雅。
gear-weapon#0157.flat: A blade crafted from the ocean's elements. It slices through enemies with the grace of the tides.

gear-weapon#0158.src: Only years of training, of building tolerance, has allowed you resistance to the onslaught; channeling the unstoppability of a torrent unleashed. Your enemy stands no chance.
gear-weapon#0158.dst: 唯有多年的训练、逐步建立起的耐受，才让你抵挡得住这场猛攻，并得以引导那股洪流被放出时的势不可挡。你的敌人毫无胜算。
gear-weapon#0158.flat: Only years of training, of building tolerance, has allowed you resistance to the onslaught; channeling the unstoppability of a torrent unleashed. Your enemy stands no chance.

gear-weapon#0159.src: "The dead can still hear. I figure a lullaby might help convince them to sleep a bit longer." -Merloni, {p} Priest
gear-weapon#0159.dst: 「死人还听得见。我想唱首摇篮曲，说不定能哄他们多睡一会儿。」——Merloni，{p} 祭司
gear-weapon#0159.flat: "The dead can still hear. I figure a lullaby might help convince them to sleep a bit longer." -Merloni, {p} Priest
gear-weapon#0159._raw: "The dead can still hear. I figure a lullaby might help convince them to sleep a bit longer." -Merloni, Saint's Row Priest

gear-weapon#0160.src: An attempt to bring power into the hands of one: wealth weaponized across a province to this end. A hero revolted. Crystals burned and plans were brought to dust.
gear-weapon#0160.dst: 一次试图把权力集中于一人之手的尝试：为此把整个行省的财富化为武器。一位英雄起身反抗。水晶焚毁，计划化为尘土。
gear-weapon#0160.flat: An attempt to bring power into the hands of one: wealth weaponized across a province to this end. A hero revolted. Crystals burned and plans were brought to dust.

gear-weapon#0161.src: Intricate carvings and images, almost like that of a totem pole, cover the shaft of this marvelous trident, dredged up from the {p}. Foreign magics heighten the senses of its user in battle, but also instills a longing for the ocean. Many have succumbed to this urge and drowned themselves.
gear-weapon#0161.dst: 这把奇妙的三叉戟是从 {p} 打捞上来的，戟杆上布满繁复的雕刻与图像，几乎像图腾柱一样。异域的魔法会在战斗中让使用者感官更敏锐，却也会让人对大海生出一股渴望。许多人没能抵挡这股冲动，投海溺死了。
gear-weapon#0161.flat: Intricate carvings and images, almost like that of a totem pole, cover the shaft of this marvelous trident, dredged up from the {p}. Foreign magics heighten the senses of its user in battle, but also instills a longing for the ocean. Many have succumbed to this urge and drowned themselves.
gear-weapon#0161._raw: Intricate carvings and images, almost like that of a totem pole, cover the shaft of this marvelous trident, dredged up from the Seavale Reef. Foreign magics heighten the senses of its user in battle, but also instills a longing for the ocean. Many have succumbed to this urge and drowned themselves.

gear-weapon#0162.src: This bow, used by the dwarves to land the final blow in the slaughter of Garaheth, is extremely powerful. Special fire resistant gloves must be worn at all times to prevent burns to the user.
gear-weapon#0162.dst: 矮人在屠杀 Garaheth 时，就是用这张弓给出最后一击的，威力极强。使用者必须全程戴着特制的防火手套，以免烫伤。
gear-weapon#0162.flat: This bow, used by the dwarves to land the final blow in the slaughter of Garaheth, is extremely powerful. Special fire resistant gloves must be worn at all times to prevent burns to the user.

gear-weapon#0163.src: Forged with flaming scales shorn from Ozoth, the fabled Golden Ninja of the {p} hunted his prey relentlessly using this lightweight, yet harder than steel, polearm.
gear-weapon#0163.dst: 这柄长柄武器用从 Ozoth 身上剪下的火焰鳞片锻成，轻巧却比钢更硬。{p} 传说中的黄金忍者曾用它毫不留情地追猎猎物。
gear-weapon#0163.flat: Forged with flaming scales shorn from Ozoth, the fabled Golden Ninja of the {p} hunted his prey relentlessly using this lightweight, yet harder than steel, polearm.
gear-weapon#0163._raw: Forged with flaming scales shorn from Ozoth, the fabled Golden Ninja of the Canyon of the Lost hunted his prey relentlessly using this lightweight, yet harder than steel, polearm.

gear-weapon#0164.src: "I am not making this up! That spider teleported ONTO MY FACE!" -Stiba, Elemental Researcher
gear-weapon#0164.dst: 「我没有乱编！那只蜘蛛直接瞬移到我脸上！」——Stiba，元素研究员
gear-weapon#0164.flat: "I am not making this up! That spider teleported ONTO MY FACE!" -Stiba, Elemental Researcher

gear-weapon#0165.src: The act of self-immolation is never taken lightly, and is always a sacrifice. This idol was carved to honor one such instance, in which a master of flame burned through his life force in a final act of heroism-purging an encroaching army of the undead, saving the people of the jungle from destruction.
gear-weapon#0165.dst: 自焚从来不是轻率之举，那永远是一种牺牲。这尊雕像正是为了纪念其中一次而刻——一位掌火的大师燃尽了自己的生命力，以英雄之姿完成最后一件事：净化一支步步进逼的不死大军，将丛林的人们从毁灭之中救了下来。
gear-weapon#0165.flat: The act of self-immolation is never taken lightly, and is always a sacrifice.
