This idol was carved to honor one such instance, in which a master of flame burned through his life force in a final act of heroism-purging an encroaching army of the undead, saving the people of the jungle from destruction.

gear-weapon#0166.src: Prolonged exposure to the corruption may cause sudden bursts of madness in soldiers. To assure themselves of their sanity, some have even begun to play tricks on their brethren.
gear-weapon#0166.dst: 长期暴露在腐化之中，可能让士兵突然陷入疯狂。为了确认自己还清醒，有些人甚至开始捉弄同袍。
gear-weapon#0166.flat: Prolonged exposure to the corruption may cause sudden bursts of madness in soldiers. To assure themselves of their sanity, some have even begun to play tricks on their brethren.

gear-weapon#0167.src: She wears a dozen masks, each fragile as the surface of a lake. The shards of her discarded personage are sharp enough to kill.
gear-weapon#0167.dst: 她戴着十几张面具，每一张都薄得像湖面。而她丢弃的那些人格的碎片，锋利得足以杀人。
gear-weapon#0167.flat: She wears a dozen masks, each fragile as the surface of a lake. The shards of her discarded personage are sharp enough to kill.

gear-weapon#0168.src: Trapped within the deep reaches of the void holes for millenia, this ancient relic has been unrecognizably warped by its own nonexistence. Instead of integrating back to reality upon its return, it brings with it the manic dissociation from a world that cannot be understood.
gear-weapon#0168.dst: 这件远古遗物在虚空洞的深处被困了上千年，被它自身的不存在扭曲得面目全非。回来之后，它非但没有重新融入现实，反而带回了一种来自无法理解之世界的狂乱疏离感。
gear-weapon#0168.flat: Trapped within the deep reaches of the void holes for millenia, this ancient relic has been unrecognizably warped by its own nonexistence. Instead of integrating back to reality upon its return, it brings with it the manic dissociation from a world that cannot be understood.

gear-weapon#0169.src: Holding this staff, you feel less . . . physical. Less real. The wind blows through you, blows past you, as though this world wasn't meant for you at all.
gear-weapon#0169.dst: 握着这根法杖，你觉得自己没那么……实在了。没那么真实。风从你身体里穿过、从你身旁吹过，仿佛这个世界根本就不是为你准备的。
gear-weapon#0169.flat: Holding this staff, you feel less . . . physical. Less real. The wind blows through you, blows past you, as though this world wasn't meant for you at all.

gear-weapon#0170.src: A curious prototype from the labs of Sock Brewing, simply looking at this liquored effigy begins to induce vertigo, tipsiness, and then shortly afterward the ever-familiar mania which only drink can inspire.
gear-weapon#0170.dst: 这是 Sock 酿酒厂实验室里一件古怪的原型品。光是盯着这尊泡着酒的雕像看，就会开始头晕、微醉，没多久便涌上那股再熟悉不过、只有酒才激得起的狂热。
gear-weapon#0170.flat: A curious prototype from the labs of Sock Brewing, simply looking at this liquored effigy begins to induce vertigo, tipsiness, and then shortly afterward the ever-familiar mania which only drink can inspire.

gear-weapon#0171.src: The Dogun God Garaheth was actually an immense fire demon occupying the bowels of {p}. Although unwise, the Dwarves forged a demonic dagger using his tooth in celebration of his slaughter.
gear-weapon#0171.dst: Dogun 人的神 Garaheth，其实是一头盘踞在 {p} 深处的巨大火焰恶魔。尽管此举并不明智，矮人仍用它的一颗牙锻造出这把恶魔匕首，以庆祝屠杀它的功绩。
gear-weapon#0171.flat: The Dogun God Garaheth was actually an immense fire demon occupying the bowels of {p}. Although unwise, the Dwarves forged a demonic dagger using his tooth in celebration of his slaughter.
gear-weapon#0171._raw: The Dogun God Garaheth was actually an immense fire demon occupying the bowels of Molten Heights. Although unwise, the Dwarves forged a demonic dagger using his tooth in celebration of his slaughter.

gear-weapon#0172.src: From coals to conflagration, the flames of War flicker forever.It's pulling towards something.
gear-weapon#0172.dst: 从余烬到燎原大火，战争之火永远闪烁不熄。它正被什么东西牵引着。
gear-weapon#0172.flat: From coals to conflagration, the flames of War flicker forever.It's pulling towards something.

gear-weapon#0173.src: For when one needs to carve the smallest stone or pick the smallest lock, the subtleties of precision approach impossibility.
gear-weapon#0173.dst: 要雕最小的石头、撬最小的锁时，精准的微妙之处几乎近于不可能。
gear-weapon#0173.flat: For when one needs to carve the smallest stone or pick the smallest lock, the subtleties of precision approach impossibility.

gear-weapon#0174.src: If you reach for ammunition from your quiver, as long as you have a single arrow, you will find you never run out.
gear-weapon#0174.dst: 只要箭袋里还剩一支箭，你伸手去拿时就会发现，箭永远拿不完。
gear-weapon#0174.flat: If you reach for ammunition from your quiver, as long as you have a single arrow, you will find you never run out.

gear-weapon#0175.src: This knife does not belong in your hands... yet somehow it feels right at home.
gear-weapon#0175.dst: 这把刀不该握在你手里……可不知怎么的，它在你手里就像回到了家。
gear-weapon#0175.flat: This knife does not belong in your hands... yet somehow it feels right at home.

gear-weapon#0176.src: Deceptively plain-looking, this bow has been infused with energy from all five known elements. Its string radiates a spectrum of colors.
gear-weapon#0176.dst: 这把弓看似平淡无奇，却灌注了已知五种元素的全部能量。弓弦散发着七彩光谱。
gear-weapon#0176.flat: Deceptively plain-looking, this bow has been infused with energy from all five known elements. Its string radiates a spectrum of colors.

gear-weapon#0177.src: Deceptively plain-looking, this dagger has been infused with energy from all five known elements. It leaves afterimages that pulsate in a spectrum of colors.
gear-weapon#0177.dst: 这把匕首看似平淡无奇，却灌注了已知五种元素的全部能量。它会留下以七彩光谱脉动的残影。
gear-weapon#0177.flat: Deceptively plain-looking, this dagger has been infused with energy from all five known elements. It leaves afterimages that pulsate in a spectrum of colors.

gear-weapon#0178.src: Deceptively plain-looking, this relik has been infused with energy from all five known elements. The head gleams in a spectrum of colors.
gear-weapon#0178.dst: 这把遗物法器看似平淡无奇，却灌注了已知五种元素的全部能量。顶端闪耀着七彩光谱。
gear-weapon#0178.flat: Deceptively plain-looking, this relik has been infused with energy from all five known elements. The head gleams in a spectrum of colors.

gear-weapon#0179.src: Deceptively plain-looking, this spear has been infused with energy from all five known elements. Its tip shimmers in a spectrum of colors.
gear-weapon#0179.dst: 这把长矛看似平淡无奇，却灌注了已知五种元素的全部能量。矛尖闪烁着七彩光谱。
gear-weapon#0179.flat: Deceptively plain-looking, this spear has been infused with energy from all five known elements. Its tip shimmers in a spectrum of colors.

gear-weapon#0180.src: Deceptively plain-looking, this wand has been infused with energy from all five known elements. It subtly glows in a spectrum of colors.
gear-weapon#0180.dst: 这把魔杖看似平淡无奇，却灌注了已知五种元素的全部能量。它隐隐泛着七彩光谱。
gear-weapon#0180.flat: Deceptively plain-looking, this wand has been infused with energy from all five known elements. It subtly glows in a spectrum of colors.

gear-weapon#0181.src: Excessive force is an ideal to strive for. Disproportionate violence is your right to protect.
gear-weapon#0181.dst: 过度使用武力是值得追求的理想。不成比例的暴力是你该捍卫的权利。
gear-weapon#0181.flat: Excessive force is an ideal to strive for. Disproportionate violence is your right to protect.

gear-weapon#0182.src: They have pillaged your faithful houses and razed your sacred fields. Imbued within this lance is an aspect of holy power, and with it you will bring Hell itself up to meet these vile transgressors.
gear-weapon#0182.dst: 他们劫掠了你信众的房屋，烧毁了你神圣的田地。这柄骑枪里灌注了一份神圣之力，你将用它把地狱本身拉上来，迎击这些卑劣的侵犯者。
gear-weapon#0182.flat: They have pillaged your faithful houses and razed your sacred fields. Imbued within this lance is an aspect of holy power, and with it you will bring Hell itself up to meet these vile transgressors.

gear-weapon#0183.src: It has witnessed the rise and fall of thousands of civilizations. It has observed the birth and death of millions of stars. It has seen universes open and close. It watches... as each second of eternity passes.
gear-weapon#0183.dst: 它见证过数千个文明的兴衰。它观测过数百万颗星辰的诞生与死亡。它看过宇宙的开启与闭合。它注视着……永恒的每一秒流逝。
gear-weapon#0183.flat: It has witnessed the rise and fall of thousands of civilizations. It has observed the birth and death of millions of stars. It has seen universes open and close. It watches... as each second of eternity passes.

gear-weapon#0184.src: These bulky-looking gauntlets are actually extremely lightweight, being created of a magical elf-blessed iron alloy blend.
gear-weapon#0184.dst: 这副护手看起来笨重，其实极其轻巧，用的是受过精灵祝福的魔法铁合金。
gear-weapon#0184.flat: These bulky-looking gauntlets are actually extremely lightweight, being created of a magical elf-blessed iron alloy blend.

gear-weapon#0185.src: Many said making a bow out of iron would be slow and wasteful, but the weight of the iron arrow can pierce even stone.
gear-weapon#0185.dst: 很多人说用铁做弓既迟钝又浪费，但铁箭的重量连石头都射得穿。
gear-weapon#0185.flat: Many said making a bow out of iron would be slow and wasteful, but the weight of the iron arrow can pierce even stone.

gear-weapon#0186.src: The holy blade of the House of Talor was crafted of pure unicorn horns, and consecrated by a hundred priests. Evil spirits are driven away by its mere presence.
gear-weapon#0186.dst: Talor 家族的圣剑以纯独角兽角打造，并由一百位祭司祝圣。光是它在场，就能驱散邪灵。
gear-weapon#0186.flat: The holy blade of the House of Talor was crafted of pure unicorn horns, and consecrated by a hundred priests. Evil spirits are driven away by its mere presence.

gear-weapon#0187.src: "The vines you'll find among the foliage make for great rope!" -Alekin's Guide to Plant Fiber Cordage
gear-weapon#0187.dst: 「枝叶间找到的藤蔓可以做成很好的绳子！」——《Alekin 植物纤维绳索指南》
gear-weapon#0187.flat: "The vines you'll find among the foliage make for great rope!" -Alekin's Guide to Plant Fiber Cordage

gear-weapon#0188.src: You do not recognize this place. A labyrinth of foreign walls closes in on you. Paths you have walked a thousand times now alien. Are these your hands? They are made of unfamiliar flesh.
gear-weapon#0188.dst: 你认不出这个地方。一座由陌生墙壁构成的迷宫朝你逼近。走过上千次的路如今变得陌生。这是你的手吗？它们是用陌生的血肉做成的。
gear-weapon#0188.flat: You do not recognize this place. A labyrinth of foreign walls closes in on you. Paths you have walked a thousand times now alien. Are these your hands? They are made of unfamiliar flesh.

gear-weapon#0189.src: "Bandit attacks losing you sleep? Free fighting classes here! Only {~} emeralds- they won't know what hit 'em!" -{p} Self-Defense Class Advertisement
gear-weapon#0189.dst: 「被强盗吓得睡不着？这里有免费格斗课！只要 {~} 绿宝石——保证打得他们晕头转向！」——{p} 防身课程广告
gear-weapon#0189.flat: "Bandit attacks losing you sleep? Free fighting classes here! Only {~} emeralds- they won't know what hit 'em!" -{p} Self-Defense Class Advertisement
gear-weapon#0189._raw: "Bandit attacks losing you sleep? Free fighting classes here! Only 10 emeralds- they won't know what hit 'em!" -Almuj Self-Defense Class Advertisement

gear-weapon#0190.src: Soldiers and sorcerers, mere men who think themselves judgement. Not so. Judgement is beyond the sword, beyond the staff; justice prefers different weapons. There is nothing, nothing at all, out of its reach.
gear-weapon#0190.dst: 士兵与术士，不过是自以为是裁决的凡人罢了。并非如此。裁决在剑之外、在杖之外；正义偏好的是别种武器。没有任何东西，一丁点也没有，能逃出它的掌心。
gear-weapon#0190.flat: Soldiers and sorcerers, mere men who think themselves judgement. Not so. Judgement is beyond the sword, beyond the staff; justice prefers different weapons. There is nothing, nothing at all, out of its reach.

gear-weapon#0191.src: "When payback is the rule of the land, it feels safest to do nothing."  -Ormrod, Self-exiled {p} Resident
gear-weapon#0191.dst: 「当以牙还牙成了这片土地的规矩，什么都不做反而最安全。」——Ormrod，自我放逐的 {p} 居民
gear-weapon#0191.flat: "When payback is the rule of the land, it feels safest to do nothing."  -Ormrod, Self-exiled {p} Resident
gear-weapon#0191._raw: "When payback is the rule of the land, it feels safest to do nothing."  -Ormrod, Self-exiled Almuj Resident

gear-weapon#0192.src: This bow, which grants its wielder the gift of increased sight, was forged by a blind blacksmith determined to protect others from his sightless fate.
gear-weapon#0192.dst: 这张弓能赐予持有者更敏锐的视力，打造它的却是一位盲眼铁匠——他决心不让别人落得跟他一样看不见的命运。
gear-weapon#0192.flat: This bow, which grants its wielder the gift of increased sight, was forged by a blind blacksmith determined to protect others from his sightless fate.

gear-weapon#0193.src: Left. Right. Left. Right. They are desperate for an escape, merely playthings in a maze of your design. Left. Left. Right.  Turn back. When mountains of stone can shift at your command, their world is reduced to a single path. Left. Right. Does it ever end?
gear-weapon#0193.dst: 左。右。左。右。他们拼命想逃，不过是你所设计的迷宫里的玩物。左。左。右。回头。当一座座石山都能随你的号令移动，他们的世界就只剩下一条路。左。右。这有尽头吗？
gear-weapon#0193.flat: Left. Right. Left. Right. They are desperate for an escape, merely playthings in a maze of your design. Left. Left. Right.  Turn back. When mountains of stone can shift at your command, their world is reduced to a single path. Left. Right. Does it ever end?

gear-weapon#0194.src: When the lost city of Sarnfic sunk beneath the depths, nothing but the bubbles of screams and this single wand surfaced. When used, you can still hear the town's lament.
gear-weapon#0194.dst: 失落之城 Sarnfic 沉入深海时，浮上水面的只有尖叫化成的泡泡，以及这一根魔杖。使用它时，你仍能听见那座城的哀歌。
gear-weapon#0194.flat: When the lost city of Sarnfic sunk beneath the depths, nothing but the bubbles of screams and this single wand surfaced. When used, you can still hear the town's lament.

gear-weapon#0195.src: A rage unseen, yet so beautiful, that when you laid your eyes upon it, you knew it had to be unleashed. No matter the cost.
gear-weapon#0195.dst: 一股看不见的怒火，却美得让你一眼望去就知道：它非得释放出来不可。不惜任何代价。
gear-weapon#0195.flat: A rage unseen, yet so beautiful, that when you laid your eyes upon it, you knew it had to be unleashed. No matter the cost.

gear-weapon#0196.src: Many have tried to duplicate the properties of this spear, but very few have succeeded in enchanting a spearhead with explosive magic that does not cause the spear itself to explode.
gear-weapon#0196.dst: 许多人试图复制这杆矛的特性，但极少有人能成功在矛尖上附加爆裂魔法、同时又不让矛本身跟着炸开。
gear-weapon#0196.flat: Many have tried to duplicate the properties of this spear, but very few have succeeded in enchanting a spearhead with explosive magic that does not cause the spear itself to explode.

gear-weapon#0197.src:
"Against all heed, to Fruma eternal."
The engraving appears extremely weathered.
gear-weapon#0197.dst:
「不顾一切警告，献给永恒的 Fruma。」
这段刻字已经风化得非常严重。
gear-weapon#0197.flat: "Against all heed, to Fruma eternal." The engraving appears extremely weathered.

gear-weapon#0198.src: Skien's trust in others was shattered permanently by the wielder of this dagger, who fell to the corruption and attacked his legion during a great corrupted siege.
gear-weapon#0198.dst: Skien 对他人的信任，被这把匕首的持有者永远地击碎了——那人在一场大规模腐化围城中堕入腐化，反过来攻击了他的军团。
gear-weapon#0198.flat: Skien's trust in others was shattered permanently by the wielder of this dagger, who fell to the corruption and attacked his legion during a great corrupted siege.

gear-weapon#0199.src: The name has got to be misspelled... It doesn't even make any sense!
gear-weapon#0199.dst: 这名字一定是拼错了……根本说不通嘛！
gear-weapon#0199.flat: The name has got to be misspelled... It doesn't even make any sense!

gear-weapon#0200.src: The once-chief of the Iboju tribe held a sacred duty: a revitalizing defense of the jungle, reducing smoldering bones of invaders to rich ash that fed the soil. Yet, as the undead plight wore on, duty curdled into obsession. He became the very monster he sought to destroy, seeing horrors in every living soul and purging them for a land he lost his mind to save.
gear-weapon#0200.dst: Iboju 部族的前任族长肩负一项神圣职责：守护丛林、让它重获生机，把入侵者冒烟的骨头烧成滋养土壤的肥沃灰烬。然而随着亡灵之灾拖得越来越久，职责渐渐变质成了执念。他成了自己想要消灭的那种怪物，在每一个活人身上都看见恐怖，为了一片他为之失去理智的土地而把他们一一清除。
gear-weapon#0200.flat: The once-chief of the Iboju tribe held a sacred duty: a revitalizing defense of the jungle, reducing smoldering bones of invaders to rich ash that fed the soil. Yet, as the undead plight wore on, duty curdled into obsession. He became the very monster he sought to destroy, seeing horrors in every living soul and purging them for a land he lost his mind to save.

gear-weapon#0201.src: Roll the dice, hit a match. You never miss.
gear-weapon#0201.dst: 掷下骰子，凑成一对。你从不失手。
gear-weapon#0201.flat: Roll the dice, hit a match. You never miss.

gear-weapon#0202.src: The real power in madness comes not from some supernatural vigour, but from a sudden lack of interest in self-preservation, and the ensuing ability to do whatever you want.
gear-weapon#0202.dst: 疯狂真正的力量，并不来自什么超自然的活力，而是来自突然对自保失去兴趣，以及随之而来、想干什么就干什么的本事。
gear-weapon#0202.flat: The real power in madness comes not from some supernatural vigour, but from a sudden lack of interest in self-preservation, and the ensuing ability to do whatever you want.

gear-weapon#0203.src: The mirror at the core of this artefact reflects back an image of a citadel that does not exist anywhere on this planet.
gear-weapon#0203.dst: 这件器物核心的镜子，映出一座在这颗星球上任何地方都不存在的堡城。
gear-weapon#0203.flat: The mirror at the core of this artefact reflects back an image of a citadel that does not exist anywhere on this planet.

gear-weapon#0204.src: From the Nether Gate, a shard of cosmic stone was ejected. Its purity was defiled, and the first man to wield it went mad, raving about the fall of the cosmos' beauty.
gear-weapon#0204.dst: 一块宇宙石碎片从下界之门被抛了出来。它的纯净遭到玷污，第一个挥舞它的人发了疯，嘴里不停念叨着宇宙之美的陨落。
gear-weapon#0204.flat: From the Nether Gate, a shard of cosmic stone was ejected. Its purity was defiled, and the first man to wield it went mad, raving about the fall of the cosmos' beauty.

gear-weapon#0205.src: Your soul is stained. Covered in the dirt of deceit and the muck of murder, the sins haunt your every step. Burn it all away, purify your existence in a flash of brilliant light.
gear-weapon#0205.dst: 你的灵魂已被玷污。满身欺骗的尘垢与杀戮的污泥，罪孽如影随形。把这一切烧个干净，在一道耀眼的光芒中净化你的存在。
gear-weapon#0205.flat: Your soul is stained. Covered in the dirt of deceit and the muck of murder, the sins haunt your every step. Burn it all away, purify your existence in a flash of brilliant light.

gear-weapon#0206.src: "Only the most wicked in Gavel could dream of a circumstance as what plagues this Wynn province." -King of {p}
gear-weapon#0206.dst: 「只有 Gavel 最邪恶的人，才想得出折磨 Wynn 行省的这种处境。」——{p} 国王
gear-weapon#0206.flat: "Only the most wicked in Gavel could dream of a circumstance as what plagues this Wynn province." -King of {p}
gear-weapon#0206._raw: "Only the most wicked in Gavel could dream of a circumstance as what plagues this Wynn province." -King of Ragni

gear-weapon#0207.src: Lost by master sailor Carvel in a massive storm, it was carried all the way out to the city of {p}, where it was found spewing seafoam and lightning bolts.
gear-weapon#0207.dst: 航海大师 Carvel 在一场巨大的风暴中把它弄丢了；它一路被冲到 {p} 城，被人发现时正喷着海沫与闪电。
gear-weapon#0207.flat: Lost by master sailor Carvel in a massive storm, it was carried all the way out to the city of {p}, where it was found spewing seafoam and lightning bolts.
gear-weapon#0207._raw: Lost by master sailor Carvel in a massive storm, it was carried all the way out to the city of Selchar, where it was found spewing seafoam and lightning bolts.

gear-weapon#0208.src: You wouldn't even think of committing these atrocities, would you? But what if you weren't the one in control?
gear-weapon#0208.dst: 你连想都不会想去犯下这些暴行，对吧？但要是掌控一切的不是你呢？
gear-weapon#0208.flat: You wouldn't even think of committing these atrocities, would you? But what if you weren't the one in control?

gear-weapon#0209.src: This short spear was the first weapon to be produced by the villagers for sale. They are old, but strong.
gear-weapon#0209.dst: 这种短矛是村民最早量产来卖的武器。它们很旧，但很结实。
gear-weapon#0209.flat: This short spear was the first weapon to be produced by the villagers for sale. They are old, but strong.

gear-weapon#0210.src: Aloft among the rafters of the crowded theatre a grin crept from ear to ear. Dim the lights. Tick. Raise the curtains. Tick. This shall be their final act. Tick.
gear-weapon#0210.dst: 在座无虚席的剧院梁架高处，一个笑容慢慢咧到了耳根。熄灯。滴答。拉开帷幕。滴答。这将是他们的最后一幕。滴答。
gear-weapon#0210.flat: Aloft among the rafters of the crowded theatre a grin crept from ear to ear. Dim the lights. Tick. Raise the curtains. Tick. This shall be their final act. Tick.

gear-weapon#0211.src: They tense. They know they must hide. The bow will see to it. You will seek. You will find them. The bow will see to it. They will heed your call. They will know your face. The bow will see to it.
gear-weapon#0211.dst: 他们绷紧了身子。他们知道自己必须躲起来。弓会搞定的。你会去找。你会找到他们。弓会搞定的。他们会听从你的召唤。他们会记住你的脸。弓会搞定的。
gear-weapon#0211.flat: They tense. They know they must hide. The bow will see to it. You will seek. You will find them. The bow will see to it. They will heed your call. They will know your face. The bow will see to it.

gear-weapon#0212.src: Spiritual enlightenment is a goal that many monks hope to one day grasp the barest glimpse of, often thought to be a goal that must be worked towards over a lifetime. Holding this polished, translucent blade will instantly induce that lofty state until it is let go.
gear-weapon#0212.dst: 灵性的开悟是许多僧侣毕生盼望能窥见一丝的境界，一般认为那是得用一辈子去修的功课。而握住这片打磨得晶莹剔透的刃，会让人瞬间进入那个崇高的状态——直到松手为止。
gear-weapon#0212.flat: Spiritual enlightenment is a goal that many monks hope to one day grasp the barest glimpse of, often thought to be a goal that must be worked towards over a lifetime. Holding this polished, translucent blade will instantly induce that lofty state until it is let go.

gear-weapon#0213.src: When one has climbed the highest mountain, traversed the vastest plain, what is left to conquer? One challenges the human limit, and attempts to push beyond what any has accomplished before. Sculpted in honor of the first champion, this idol emboldens you to best your greatest opponent: yourself.
gear-weapon#0213.dst: 当一个人已经登上最高的山、走过最辽阔的平原，还剩下什么可以征服？那就去挑战人类的极限，试着超越前人未曾做到的成就。这尊神像为纪念第一位冠军而雕，激励你去战胜你最大的对手：你自己。
gear-weapon#0213.flat: When one has climbed the highest mountain, traversed the vastest plain, what is left to conquer? One challenges the human limit, and attempts to push beyond what any has accomplished before. Sculpted in honor of the first champion, this idol emboldens you to best your greatest opponent: yourself.

gear-weapon#0214.src: Carved directly from the mysterious rock that hit Gavel {~} years ago, this pure white wand glows with cosmic energy unknown.
gear-weapon#0214.dst: 这根纯白魔杖直接取材于 {~} 年前撞上 Gavel 的那块神秘岩石，散发着未知的宇宙能量。
gear-weapon#0214.flat: Carved directly from the mysterious rock that hit Gavel {~} years ago, this pure white wand glows with cosmic energy unknown.
gear-weapon#0214._raw: Carved directly from the mysterious rock that hit Gavel 50 years ago, this pure white wand glows with cosmic energy unknown.

gear-weapon#0215.src: The existence of all things is reflected in the otherworldly jewels of this grand staff, dense enough to have its own gravitational pull. Users have reported their limbs being stretched after usage.
gear-weapon#0215.dst: 万物的存在都映照在这根宏伟法杖那些异界的宝石里，宝石密度高到有自己的引力。有使用者回报，用过之后四肢都被拉长了。
gear-weapon#0215.flat: The existence of all things is reflected in the otherworldly jewels of this grand staff, dense enough to have its own gravitational pull. Users have reported their limbs being stretched after usage.

gear-weapon#0216.src: The Elves managed to harness the power of air itself, forming a bow made entirely of air currents, allowing the user to move swift like the wind, but vulnerable to attacks.
gear-weapon#0216.dst: 精灵成功驾驭了空气本身的力量，做出一把完全由气流构成的弓；它让使用者能如风一般迅捷，却也让他在攻击面前毫无防备。
gear-weapon#0216.flat: The Elves managed to harness the power of air itself, forming a bow made entirely of air currents, allowing the user to move swift like the wind, but vulnerable to attacks.

gear-weapon#0217.src: "Controlled burns are healthy, but it's clear why no one wants to do them." -Darek, Alekin Trailblazer
gear-weapon#0217.dst: 「计划烧除对林子有好处，但也不难理解为什么没人愿意干。」——Darek，Alekin 开路人
gear-weapon#0217.flat: "Controlled burns are healthy, but it's clear why no one wants to do them." -Darek, Alekin Trailblazer

gear-weapon#0218.src: "If you squish a spider egg, sometimes little spiders pop out. So, squish the whole area instead!" -Captain Fenor, {p} Legion
gear-weapon#0218.dst: 「踩破一颗蜘蛛卵，有时候会跳出小蜘蛛。所以干脆把整片都踩烂！」——Fenor 队长，{p} 军团
gear-weapon#0218.flat: "If you squish a spider egg, sometimes little spiders pop out. So, squish the whole area instead!" -Captain Fenor, {p} Legion
gear-weapon#0218._raw: "If you squish a spider egg, sometimes little spiders pop out. So, squish the whole area instead!" -Captain Fenor, Detlas Legion

gear-weapon#0219.src: When the two opposing Realms come to blows, War lashes out with blind enmity. Such is the nature of a Devil, each born from the hate those two Beasts bear.
gear-weapon#0219.dst: 当两个对立的领域交战，战争便以盲目的敌意四处挥击。这就是恶魔的本性——每一个都诞生于那两头巨兽所怀的憎恨。
gear-weapon#0219.flat: When the two opposing Realms come to blows, War lashes out with blind enmity. Such is the nature of a Devil, each born from the hate those two Beasts bear.

gear-weapon#0220.src: The two mesa tribes once were allies until their sacred totems were stolen. Before that time, however, they often shared their talents, and this bow hewn from mesa stone was one such lost craft.
gear-weapon#0220.dst: 台地的两个部族原本是盟友，直到他们的神圣图腾被偷。不过在那之前，他们常常互相分享技艺，而这张以台地岩石凿成的弓，正是其中一项失传的手艺。
gear-weapon#0220.flat: The two mesa tribes once were allies until their sacred totems were stolen. Before that time, however, they often shared their talents, and this bow hewn from mesa stone was one such lost craft.

gear-weapon#0221.src: "I have to wonder just how healthy slime found in the depths of a desert  cavern can be to drink." -Eluzterp, {p} resident
gear-weapon#0221.dst: 「我实在很怀疑，从沙漠洞穴深处找到的黏液喝下去能有多健康。」——Eluzterp，{p} 居民
gear-weapon#0221.flat: "I have to wonder just how healthy slime found in the depths of a desert  cavern can be to drink." -Eluzterp, {p} resident
gear-weapon#0221._raw: "I have to wonder just how healthy slime found in the depths of a desert  cavern can be to drink." -Eluzterp, Almuj resident

gear-weapon#0222.src: To hunt in the {p} is always an opportunity. Perhaps hidden between the trees, behind the shrubs, above the canopy, or even within the shadows just behind you, mirroring your every step.
gear-weapon#0222.dst: 在 {p} 狩猎总是一个机会。猎物也许藏在树与树之间、灌木后面、树冠上方，甚至就在你身后的阴影里，模仿着你的每一步。
gear-weapon#0222.flat: To hunt in the {p} is always an opportunity. Perhaps hidden between the trees, behind the shrubs, above the canopy, or even within the shadows just behind you, mirroring your every step.
gear-weapon#0222._raw: To hunt in the Mistwoods is always an opportunity. Perhaps hidden between the trees, behind the shrubs, above the canopy, or even within the shadows just behind you, mirroring your every step.

gear-weapon#0223.src: This wand merges with the user on touch, bringing about horrific changes to them. Elongated nails, sharp teeth and the ability to breathe fire are trademarks of the beast.
gear-weapon#0223.dst: 这根魔杖一碰到使用者就会与之融合，带来骇人的变化。变长的指甲、尖利的牙齿，以及喷火的能力，都是那头野兽的标志。
gear-weapon#0223.flat: This wand merges with the user on touch, bringing about horrific changes to them. Elongated nails, sharp teeth and the ability to breathe fire are trademarks of the beast.

gear-weapon#0224.src: One of many lost artifacts from the legendary Wind Fortress, the engraving appears to be a cryptic clue to where the Fortress fell. "We shall be found among the dark winds of the morrow."
gear-weapon#0224.dst: 风之要塞众多失落遗物之一；上面的刻字看起来像是关于要塞坠落之处的一则谜样线索：“我们将在明日的暗风之中被寻见。”
gear-weapon#0224.flat: One of many lost artifacts from the legendary Wind Fortress, the engraving appears to be a cryptic clue to where the Fortress fell. "We shall be found among the dark winds of the morrow."

gear-weapon#0225.src: The world revolves around you, after all. It's high time you spread the news!
gear-weapon#0225.dst: 毕竟世界是绕着你转的。是时候把这个消息传出去了！
gear-weapon#0225.flat: The world revolves around you, after all. It's high time you spread the news!

gear-weapon#0226.src: A year-long monsoon soaked this {p}-made bow so much, that it has harnessed the very essence of water.
gear-weapon#0226.dst: 一场长达一年的季风雨把这张 {p} 制的弓泡得透透的，结果让它掌握了水的本质。
gear-weapon#0226.flat: A year-long monsoon soaked this {p}-made bow so much, that it has harnessed the very essence of water.
gear-weapon#0226._raw: A year-long monsoon soaked this Nemract-made bow so much, that it has harnessed the very essence of water.

gear-weapon#0227.src: Combined power of inscribed Uth runes and immense wisdom meld to create a commanding aura, as this weapon is merely a spiritual extension of the user's desire for dominion over all.
gear-weapon#0227.dst: 铭刻的 Uth 符文之力与浩瀚的智慧交融，形成威严的气场——这把武器不过是使用者渴望统御万物的精神延伸。
gear-weapon#0227.flat: Combined power of inscribed Uth runes and immense wisdom meld to create a commanding aura, as this weapon is merely a spiritual extension of the user's desire for dominion over all.

gear-weapon#0228.src: A string so subtle it can slip by the walls of reality, bringing its targets into the space beyond space itself.
gear-weapon#0228.dst: 一根细微到能从现实的墙缝间溜过的弦，能把目标带进空间之外的空间。
gear-weapon#0228.flat: A string so subtle it can slip by the walls of reality, bringing its targets into the space beyond space itself.

gear-weapon#0229.src: A bow drawn from the air itself. It imbues the wielder with all the spirit of the wind.
gear-weapon#0229.dst: 一张从空气本身拉出的弓。它为持有者灌注风的全部精魂。
gear-weapon#0229.flat: A bow drawn from the air itself. It imbues the wielder with all the spirit of the wind.

gear-weapon#0230.src: The diminutive stature of this item belies its abilities. Absorbing and expelling magical energy in precise bursts, it protects the user from all manner of attacks while punishing those who dare strike.
gear-weapon#0230.dst: 这件东西个头小，能耐却不小。它以精准的爆发吸收并释放魔法能量，替使用者挡下各式攻击，同时惩罚胆敢出手的人。
gear-weapon#0230.flat: The diminutive stature of this item belies its abilities. Absorbing and expelling magical energy in precise bursts, it protects the user from all manner of attacks while punishing those who dare strike.

gear-weapon#0231.src: This sacrificial kris, fallen from the peak of the {p}, is completely hollow. To wield it is to invite to yourself the same hollowness. To become such an aberration, to unwrite yourself in pursuit of power...it must be fed of its wielder til only the barest existence remains.
gear-weapon#0231.dst: 这把从 {p} 顶峰坠落的献祭用克力士短剑，里头完全是空的。挥舞它，就是把同样的空洞请进自己体内。要成为这样的异类，要为了追求力量而抹去自己……它必须以持有者为食，直到只剩下最微薄的存在。
gear-weapon#0231.flat: This sacrificial kris, fallen from the peak of the {p}, is completely hollow. To wield it is to invite to yourself the same hollowness. To become such an aberration, to unwrite yourself in pursuit of power...it must be fed of its wielder til only the barest existence remains.
gear-weapon#0231._raw: This sacrificial kris, fallen from the peak of the Tower of Ascension, is completely hollow. To wield it is to invite to yourself the same hollowness. To become such an aberration, to unwrite yourself in pursuit of power...it must be fed of its wielder til only the barest existence remains.

gear-weapon#0232.src: This ornate knife, which fell from {p} centuries ago, is still followed by the shadows of the void, blotting out the sun in a wide area around it. Bathed in the darkness of twilight, you finally feel truly liberated, as no soul will ever see the horrors you commit.
gear-weapon#0232.dst: 这把华丽的刀是好几个世纪前从 {p} 坠落的，至今仍被虚空的阴影跟随，遮蔽了周围一大片的日光。沐浴在暮色的黑暗里，你终于感到真正的解脱——因为没有任何人会看见你犯下的恐怖之事。
gear-weapon#0232.flat: This ornate knife, which fell from {p} centuries ago, is still followed by the shadows of the void, blotting out the sun in a wide area around it. Bathed in the darkness of twilight, you finally feel truly liberated, as no soul will ever see the horrors you commit.
gear-weapon#0232._raw: This ornate knife, which fell from Ahmsord centuries ago, is still followed by the shadows of the void, blotting out the sun in a wide area around it. Bathed in the darkness of twilight, you finally feel truly liberated, as no soul will ever see the horrors you commit.

gear-weapon#0233.src: "If anyone finds this, leave it at my Gale's gravesite. I promised her a memento, too." This inscription is extremely weathered.
gear-weapon#0233.dst: 「如果有人找到这个，请把它放在我的 Gale 墓前。我也答应过要给她留个纪念。」这段铭文已经风化得非常严重。
gear-weapon#0233.flat: "If anyone finds this, leave it at my Gale's gravesite. I promised her a memento, too." This inscription is extremely weathered.

gear-weapon#0234.src: This expertly crafted bow was whittled by a cryptid-researching fanatic. Its frame was cut from the very toughest tree roots.
gear-weapon#0234.dst: 这把弓做工精湛，出自一位痴迷于研究神秘生物的狂热者之手。弓身是用最坚韧的树根削成的。
gear-weapon#0234.flat: This expertly crafted bow was whittled by a cryptid-researching fanatic. Its frame was cut from the very toughest tree roots.

gear-weapon#0235.src: This expertly crafted dagger was smithed by a cryptid-researching fanatic. It can chop through even the thickest of the swamp's clay with ease.
gear-weapon#0235.dst: 这把匕首做工精湛，出自一位痴迷于研究神秘生物的狂热者之手。连沼泽里最厚实的黏土，它也能轻松劈开。
gear-weapon#0235.flat: This expertly crafted dagger was smithed by a cryptid-researching fanatic. It can chop through even the thickest of the swamp's clay with ease.

gear-weapon#0236.src: This expertly crafted relik was notched by a cryptid-researching fanatic. Its feathers and baubles chime with a soothing melody.
gear-weapon#0236.dst: 这把遗物法器做工精湛，出自一位痴迷于研究神秘生物的狂热者之手。上头的羽毛与小饰物会叮当奏出抚慰人心的旋律。
gear-weapon#0236.flat: This expertly crafted relik was notched by a cryptid-researching fanatic. Its feathers and baubles chime with a soothing melody.

gear-weapon#0237.src: This expertly crafted spear was forged by a cryptid-researching fanatic. It shines brilliantly in even the weakest sunlight.
gear-weapon#0237.dst: 这把长矛做工精湛，出自一位痴迷于研究神秘生物的狂热者之手。就算阳光再微弱，它也闪闪发亮。
gear-weapon#0237.flat: This expertly crafted spear was forged by a cryptid-researching fanatic. It shines brilliantly in even the weakest sunlight.

gear-weapon#0238.src: This expertly crafted wand was shaped by a cryptid-researching fanatic. It shimmers with the purest water from the swamp.
gear-weapon#0238.dst: 这把魔杖做工精湛，出自一位痴迷于研究神秘生物的狂热者之手。它闪烁着沼泽里最纯净的水光。
gear-weapon#0238.flat: This expertly crafted wand was shaped by a cryptid-researching fanatic. It shimmers with the purest water from the swamp.

gear-weapon#0239.src: Everything dies. Show those who resist the foolishness of their ambitions.It's pulling towards something.
gear-weapon#0239.dst: 万物终有一死。让那些抵抗的人看清自己野心有多愚蠢。它正被什么东西牵引着。
gear-weapon#0239.flat: Everything dies. Show those who resist the foolishness of their ambitions.It's pulling towards something.

gear-weapon#0240.src: True artistry takes time... with the power to sculpt mountains and erode cliffsides into panoramas, the beliefs of your enemies are insignificant. They will understand your greatness... in due time.
gear-weapon#0240.dst: 真正的艺术需要时间……当你握有雕塑山岳、把悬崖侵蚀成全景画的力量，敌人的信念便微不足道。他们会明白你的伟大……时候到了自然会。
gear-weapon#0240.flat: True artistry takes time... with the power to sculpt mountains and erode cliffsides into panoramas, the beliefs of your enemies are insignificant. They will understand your greatness... in due time.

gear-weapon#0241.src: Holding this relik sends sparks through your veins, making your heart beat fast. And faster. And faster and faster and--
gear-weapon#0241.dst: 握着这件遗物法器，火花便窜过你的血管，让你的心跳加快。再快一点。越来越快、越来越快——
gear-weapon#0241.flat: Holding this relik sends sparks through your veins, making your heart beat fast. And faster. And faster and faster and--

gear-weapon#0243.src: They must know what you went through. They must suffer the same as you did.
gear-weapon#0243.dst: 他们必须知道你经历过什么。他们必须受你受过的苦。
gear-weapon#0243.flat: They must know what you went through. They must suffer the same as you did.

gear-weapon#0244.src: Faces have danced around you as long as you can remember, laughing, jeering, mocking. This is your surrender, casting faces of your own into the theatre of your humiliation.
gear-weapon#0244.dst: 从你有记忆以来，就有一张张脸围着你跳舞，笑着、嘘着、嘲弄着。这是你的投降——把你自己的脸也投进这座羞辱你的剧场。
gear-weapon#0244.flat: Faces have danced around you as long as you can remember, laughing, jeering, mocking. This is your surrender, casting faces of your own into the theatre of your humiliation.

gear-weapon#0245.src: "I am only human in the snow. When it melts away, so too do I, for then I am cursed to be a swan."
gear-weapon#0245.dst: 「我只有在雪中才是人。雪一融化，我也跟着消逝，因为那时我便受诅化作天鹅。」
gear-weapon#0245.flat: "I am only human in the snow. When it melts away, so too do I, for then I am cursed to be a swan."

gear-weapon#0246.src: The song of the world begins as a quiet whistle, calm and peaceful, wrapping 'round the trees and drifting lazily across the fields. It is ever so soft, yet sharper than any sword.
gear-weapon#0246.dst: 世界之歌起初只是一声轻轻的口哨，平静而安宁，缠绕着树木，懒洋洋地飘过田野。它柔和至极，却比任何剑都锋利。
gear-weapon#0246.flat: The song of the world begins as a quiet whistle, calm and peaceful, wrapping 'round the trees and drifting lazily across the fields. It is ever so soft, yet sharper than any sword.

gear-weapon#0247.src: Her crimes were against Decency. She laughed and spat, denying reason and making the world suffer for small vengeance.
gear-weapon#0247.dst: 她的罪行冒犯的是体面。她嘲笑、吐口水，否定理性，为了一点小小的报复就让全世界受苦。
gear-weapon#0247.flat: Her crimes were against Decency. She laughed and spat, denying reason and making the world suffer for small vengeance.

gear-weapon#0248.src: The magically rejuvenating properties of phoenix ash were imbued into this grand stave in its creator's bid to gain immortality.
gear-weapon#0248.dst: 为了追求长生不死，这根宏伟法杖的打造者把凤凰灰那种能以魔法焕发青春的特性灌注了进去。
gear-weapon#0248.flat: The magically rejuvenating properties of phoenix ash were imbued into this grand stave in its creator's bid to gain immortality.

gear-weapon#0249.src: Carried by the {p} Plague Doctor, this simple-looking stick subtly oozes with an unidentifiable substance that is invigorating to the holder, and lethally venomous to anything else.
gear-weapon#0249.dst: 这根看似普通的棍子由 {p} 瘟疫医生随身携带，会微微渗出一种无法辨识的物质——对持有者来说提神振气，对其他任何东西则是致命剧毒。
gear-weapon#0249.flat: Carried by the {p} Plague Doctor, this simple-looking stick subtly oozes with an unidentifiable substance that is invigorating to the holder, and lethally venomous to anything else.
gear-weapon#0249._raw: Carried by the Olux Plague Doctor, this simple-looking stick subtly oozes with an unidentifiable substance that is invigorating to the holder, and lethally venomous to anything else.

gear-weapon#0250.src: With each swing, this ornate hammer threatens to shape mountains and carve valleys, cleaving new fault lines in a single blow.
gear-weapon#0250.dst: 这把华丽的锤子每挥一下，都仿佛要塑造山岳、凿出山谷，一击就劈出新的断层。
gear-weapon#0250.flat: With each swing, this ornate hammer threatens to shape mountains and carve valleys, cleaving new fault lines in a single blow.

gear-weapon#0251.src: Wielding this molten sword, you feel your worries and empathy combust away into corrosive smoke. If one can feel so free, why should it matter if it comes to the detriment of the world around you?
gear-weapon#0251.dst: 挥舞这把熔岩之剑，你感觉自己的忧虑与同理心都燃烧殆尽，化作侵蚀一切的烟雾。如果能感到如此自由，就算代价是损害周遭的世界，又有什么关系？
gear-weapon#0251.flat: Wielding this molten sword, you feel your worries and empathy combust away into corrosive smoke. If one can feel so free, why should it matter if it comes to the detriment of the world around you?

gear-weapon#0253.src: This spear is bright enough that it can cause blindness if you look directly at it. Its immense power is limited by its weight; the weapon is nearly impossible to lift.
gear-weapon#0253.dst: 这柄长矛亮到直视就可能让人失明。它巨大的力量受限于重量——这把武器几乎举不起来。
gear-weapon#0253.flat: This spear is bright enough that it can cause blindness if you look directly at it. Its immense power is limited by its weight; the weapon is nearly impossible to lift.

gear-weapon#0254.src: This staff was expertly crafted from fragile spun glass, and tinted with various magical foci that bend light into its most raw components.
gear-weapon#0254.dst: 这根法杖以脆弱的纺丝玻璃精心制成，并掺入多种魔法聚焦物上色，能把光折射成最原始的成分。
gear-weapon#0254.flat: This staff was expertly crafted from fragile spun glass, and tinted with various magical foci that bend light into its most raw components.

gear-weapon#0255.src: The density of this weapon is almost immeasurable. Despite being light and easy to wield, the spear seems to have its own gravitational pull, slowly dragging enemies closer and making it nearly impossible to put down.
gear-weapon#0255.dst: 这把武器的密度几乎无法测量。这柄长矛轻巧好挥，却似乎有自己的引力，会慢慢把敌人拉近，而且几乎放不下手。
gear-weapon#0255.flat: The density of this weapon is almost immeasurable. Despite being light and easy to wield, the spear seems to have its own gravitational pull, slowly dragging enemies closer and making it nearly impossible to put down.

gear-weapon#0256.src: "Leave us down here to die, why don't you all. Just turn us into another statistic and be done, huh?" -Ragamal, {p} Sewer Dweller
gear-weapon#0256.dst: 「干脆把我们丢在这底下等死算了。把我们变成又一个统计数字就完事了，是吧？」——Ragamal，{p} 下水道居民
gear-weapon#0256.flat: "Leave us down here to die, why don't you all. Just turn us into another statistic and be done, huh?" -Ragamal, {p} Sewer Dweller
gear-weapon#0256._raw: "Leave us down here to die, why don't you all. Just turn us into another statistic and be done, huh?" -Ragamal, Nemract Sewer Dweller

gear-weapon#0257.src: "I always thought Yahya was venom-addled, but the symptoms don't match..." -Pyeka, Alekin Herbalist
gear-weapon#0257.dst: 「我一直以为 Yahya 是中毒中得脑子糊涂了，可症状对不上……」——Pyeka，Alekin 草药师
gear-weapon#0257.flat: "I always thought Yahya was venom-addled, but the symptoms don't match..." -Pyeka, Alekin Herbalist

gear-weapon#0258.src: The great serpent of Ahms was said to be a bringer of wisdom in days long past, revered by the inhabitants of the region. Totems like this one were crafted as an act of worship, though as belief faded over time, so too were these idols lost and destroyed. Only one remains.
gear-weapon#0258.dst: 据说在很久以前，Ahms 的巨蛇是带来智慧的存在，受到当地居民崇敬。像这样的图腾是作为敬拜而雕刻的，但随着信仰逐渐淡去，这些神像也跟着遗失、毁坏。如今只剩这一尊。
gear-weapon#0258.flat: The great serpent of Ahms was said to be a bringer of wisdom in days long past, revered by the inhabitants of the region. Totems like this one were crafted as an act of worship, though as belief faded over time, so too were these idols lost and destroyed. Only one remains.

gear-weapon#0259.src: A spear hewn from a radioactive metal. It may be toxic for the wielder, but it is fatal to its enemies.
gear-weapon#0259.dst: 一柄以放射性金属凿成的长矛。它或许对持有者有毒，对敌人却是致命的。
gear-weapon#0259.flat: A spear hewn from a radioactive metal. It may be toxic for the wielder, but it is fatal to its enemies.

gear-weapon#0260.src: A grave digger uncovered this blade from the resting place of a notorious pirate that pillaged the islands of the ocean for four decades.
gear-weapon#0260.dst: 一名掘墓人从一个恶名昭彰的海盗的长眠之地挖出了这把刀——那海盗劫掠大洋诸岛长达四十年。
gear-weapon#0260.flat: A grave digger uncovered this blade from the resting place of a notorious pirate that pillaged the islands of the ocean for four decades.

gear-weapon#0261.src: To call an end a new beginning implies there ever was a beginning, or ever will be an end.
gear-weapon#0261.dst: 把终结称作新的开始，就等于暗示曾经有过开始，或者终将有个结束。
gear-weapon#0261.flat: To call an end a new beginning implies there ever was a beginning, or ever will be an end.

gear-weapon#0262.src: The flickering flame atop this simple wand is a marvel of magic. It always burns at a comfortable heat, cannot scorch skin even if touched, and never can be snuffed out under any circumstance.
gear-weapon#0262.dst: 这根朴素魔杖顶端那簇摇曳的火焰是魔法的奇迹。它永远烧在舒适的温度，碰到也不会烫伤皮肤，而且无论如何都熄灭不了。
gear-weapon#0262.flat: The flickering flame atop this simple wand is a marvel of magic. It always burns at a comfortable heat, cannot scorch skin even if touched, and never can be snuffed out under any circumstance.

gear-weapon#0263.src: Finally, the pulse of melody and harmony flies through golden halls, flung by the momentum of life itself. A single knock of polished wood on chiselled stone, and the song of the world falls silent.
gear-weapon#0263.dst: 终于，旋律与和声的脉动掠过金色的殿堂，被生命本身的冲劲抛了出去。磨光的木头在凿过的石头上轻叩一声，世界之歌便归于寂静。
gear-weapon#0263.flat: Finally, the pulse of melody and harmony flies through golden halls, flung by the momentum of life itself. A single knock of polished wood on chiselled stone, and the song of the world falls silent.

gear-weapon#0264.src: Despite being proven unrelated, this enigmatic bow was the lynchpin to beginning the great search for the Relics.
gear-weapon#0264.dst: 尽管后来证明两者毫无关联，这张神秘的弓当初却是开启寻找遗物大行动的关键。
gear-weapon#0264.flat: Despite being proven unrelated, this enigmatic bow was the lynchpin to beginning the great search for the Relics.

gear-weapon#0265.src: Despite this mace never seeing use by Remikas, it was seen as a symbol of the might of his rule over Gavel. Its true abilities in battle have never been seen.
gear-weapon#0265.dst: Remikas 从没用过这根钉锤，它却被视为他统治 Gavel 的威权象征。它在战斗中的真正能耐，从来没有人见识过。
gear-weapon#0265.flat: Despite this mace never seeing use by Remikas, it was seen as a symbol of the might of his rule over Gavel. Its true abilities in battle have never been seen.

gear-weapon#0266.src: "Skin worked so thin, we see the bone; she grinds us up from on her throne. Their houses made of flimsy steel; scars from bombs will never heal."
gear-weapon#0266.dst: 「皮肉磨得薄见骨，她坐在王座上把我们碾成泥。他们的房子是薄铁搭的，炸弹留下的伤疤永远好不了。」
gear-weapon#0266.flat: "Skin worked so thin, we see the bone; she grinds us up from on her throne. Their houses made of flimsy steel; scars from bombs will never heal."

gear-weapon#0267.src: Her crimes were against the State. She burned and pillaged, making a mockery of law and civility throughout the land.
gear-weapon#0267.dst: 她的罪行冒犯的是国家。她放火、劫掠，让全境的法律与文明沦为笑柄。
gear-weapon#0267.flat: Her crimes were against the State. She burned and pillaged, making a mockery of law and civility throughout the land.

gear-weapon#0268.src: The power to join oneself with the lifeblood of the earth has long eluded sects of fanatical druids and shamans. One such cult found a way, and subsequently wiped itself out in the process, their flesh turning to stone and veins forming new rivers.
gear-weapon#0268.dst: 与大地的命脉合为一体的力量，长久以来都是狂热德鲁伊与萨满教派求而不得的东西。其中一个教团找到了方法，接着就在过程中把自己灭绝了——他们的血肉化作石头，血管化作新的河流。
gear-weapon#0268.flat: The power to join oneself with the lifeblood of the earth has long eluded sects of fanatical druids and shamans. One such cult found a way, and subsequently wiped itself out in the process, their flesh turning to stone and veins forming new rivers.
